You come across a daytime sleepwalker and attempt to dispel the unusual affliction [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you end up with a new member of your entourage; gain 1 Character Unique Asset. If you fail, the magic fizzles and the dreamer attacks you; lose 2 Health.

Something terrible is about to happen to your friend, but you find that your voice has been silenced. You try to communicate without using words [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you alert him to the danger; gain this Clue. If you fail, you are both enveloped in darkness; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

Nodens, Lord of the Abyss, appears before you, charging you with mending the Dreamlands. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you do not gain the Condition, he abducts you in his fury; move to The Underworld and become Delayed.

A quiet exhibit has several masterwork sculptures on display [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, a bust inscribed with the word "ΥΠΝΟΣ" catches your eye, and you leave feeling changed; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you become lost amongst the statues; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

You find a seemingly innocuous stone tablet in a quiet clearing. Touching it floods your mind with visions of the origin of the universe. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Elder Key Artifact. If you do not gain the Condition, the tablet calls a guardian; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

One of the other passengers warns you about his mother's recent sleepwalking habit [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you keep an eye out for the elderly matron, occasionally catching her wandering about the ship at night; gain this Clue. If you fail, you wake to her looming silently over your bed; lose 2 Sanity.

You wake with a bauble of unknown origin in your pocket [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find the name of its previous owner barely visible on the bottom; gain this Clue and 1 random Trinket Asset from the deck. If you fail, someone sees you handling it and accuses you of theft; gain a Detained Condition.

You dream that you are a sorcerer of widespread fame and great ability [LORE]. If you pass, the arcane theories you employ are sound and you recall them after you wake; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, the incantations you use are gibberish; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

You visit with an old sea hag, and she offers you a relic that can capture another's dreams, though it may destroy your body to claim it [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, it acknowledges you as its master; gain the Crystallizer of Dreams Artifact. If you fail, it tears your flesh to shreds; lose 2 Health.

Locating an improperly filed volume has you teetering on the edge of madness. You may spend 2 Sanity to gain 1 Tome Artifact. If you do not spend the Sanity, you are informed the next day that someone else has checked out the book; move this Clue to the nearest Dream-Quest Space.

You try to follow screams for help, but the acoustics of the canyon are playing tricks on your ears [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you discover someone who claims to have been attacked by a sleepwalking man; gain this Clue and 1 random Ally Asset from the deck. If you fail, you become lost without rations; lose 1 Health.

You have a nightmare that you are standing on deck while the ship is being buffeted by a terrible storm [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you realize that you are not actually dreaming; gain this Clue. If you fail, you loiter on the deck until the boom swings into your head; lose 2 Health.

A local laboratory is conducting a sleep study. You would be free to partake in any number of activities to entertain yourself during the process. However, the university disavows any responsibility for ill effects suffered from lack of sleep. You may spend 2 Health to gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition.

You soar like an eagle, taking in a bird's-eye view of the earth below [OBSERVATION - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you are on the Dreamlands side board. If you pass, you see a flash of silver far below; gain the Silver Key Artifact. If you fail, you lose control of the dream and plummet to the ground; lose 2 Health.

A merchant vessel has gone missing and you join the rescue crew [OBSERVATION - 1]. if you pass, you discover the ship has been taken by ghouls; gain this Clue and a Ghoul Monster ambushes you! If you fail, you find the ship but everyone on board is dead save for a rather pleased-looking cat; advance Doom by 1.

You speak with the mother of a boy who vanished in his sleep [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, she tells you of a place he described from his dreams; gain this Clue and you may discard the top card of the Dream-Quest Encounter deck. If you fail, she accuses you of taking him; gain a Detained Condition.

A shadowy being whispers to you from a distance, instructing you to follow [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you manage to keep up; gain this Clue and move to The Enchanted Wood. If you fail, you lose your way and become tangled in a thorny briar; lose 1 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

A rush of adrenaline surges through you as you realize you are trapped in a nightmare, and you attempt to uncover an exit [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you slip into the æther, freeing yourself; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you remain trapped in a room with your greatest fears; lose 2 Sanity.

You speak with a man who warns you that trouble from the Dreamlands is seeking you out [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you recognize him and he offers to accompany you; gain the Randolph Carter Unique Asset. If you fail, you disregard his warning and take no precautionary measures; advance Doom by 1.

You follow a sleepwalking man through the wilds, but he is moving with unnatural speed [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you see him get sucked into the sky by a golden light, leaving only a pocket journal behind; gain this Clue and 1 Task Unique Asset. If you fail, you lose your way; gain 1 Madness Condition.

You dream that masters from all over the world have come to teach you their trades [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you remember some of your dream when you wake; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you wake up confused and extremely seasick; lose 1 Health and gain 1 Madness Condition.

Someone has gone missing after several nights of sleepwalking, and you help search for him [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find him sleeping in a tree and he tells you about his adventures in the land of dreams; gain this Clue. If you fail, the search is long and exhausting; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

You sense that you are being stalked by a terrible presence, but no matter which way you run, you always return to the same clearing [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a path that did not exist before and the evil presence fades away; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you remain trapped; lose 1 Sanity.

A hooded man has been watching you since your journey began. You sneak away from your quarters to spy on him instead [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you notice that he does not sleep; gain this Clue. If you fail, your surveillance has not gone unnoticed; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

A luminous shape of inky black liquid coalesces before you [WILL - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you are on the Dreamlands side board. If you pass, you see the features of a hideous face; gain this Clue. If you fail, you glimpse the space beyond the face and see time unshackled before you; lose 2 Sanity.

You spot a young man on the road and try to catch up with him [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, he claims that he has little time left and gives you his things; gain this Clue and 1 random Trinket Asset from the deck. If you fail, you catch up to him but his life appears to have been drained away; lose 1 Sanity.

You scan the endless stars in the night sky for unusual celestial activity [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you note the supernatural pulsing of the Corona Borealis; gain 1 Boon Condition. If you fail, you do not notice beams of red-gold light streaking heavenward; advance the Omen by 1.

A grizzled captain claims that his ship can take you anywhere if you can afford its fare [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you sail his ship into the stars; gain 1 Boon Condition and move to Celephaïs. If you fail, you find that he has left you stranded; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

There is no ground, only the infinite void, and you try to convince yourself it is not real [WILL - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you are on the Dreamlands side board. If you pass, the stars of the Corona Borealis blaze around you as you fall; gain this Clue. If you fail, you continue to fall without end; lose 2 Sanity.

You strike up a game of cards with a quiet, hooded traveler [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, he gives you a curio from his pack but does not speak; gain this Clue and 1 random Trinket Asset from the deck. If you fail, he pulls back his hood to reveal empty black eyes; lose 2 Sanity.

You attend a night class on the meaning behind common dreams and nightmares. Gain this Clue. You realize suddenly that you forgot to put on clothes before you came and look for something to cover yourself [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, the eyes of all humanity are upon you; lose 2 Sanity.

You slip away from the madness that is consuming the cities of the waking world, losing yourself in the forests of the Dreamlands, testing the limits of your physical body and in some cases exceeding them. If you are on the Dreamlands side board, gain 1 Talent Condition and lose 1 Health.

You swim in an endless ocean of æther, trying to understand the anomalies around you [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you learn much about the foundation upon which the universe is built; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, the winds of infinity erode your mind and body; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

You dream that you are crushed by an avalanche of falling rocks. When you wake, your room is filled with large heaps of stone and dirt. Amongst the debris, you find a wreath of laurels, completely undamaged. If you are on the Dreamlands side board, gain this Clue and lose 1 Health.

As you enter a relatively untraveled area of the woods, a quiet but irresistible voice in you urges you to dig [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you excavate the bust of some unknown Greek deity; gain this Clue. If you fail, you overexert yourself digging through the night but find nothing; lose 2 Health.

One of the sailors believes he will die if he dreams, and begs you to watch over him while he sleeps. You may spend 1 Sanity to gain 1 Task Unique Asset. If you do not spend the Sanity, the sailor has disappeared the next morning; move this Clue to the nearest Dream-Quest space.

Hundreds of thousands of tiny spiders have cropped up downtown and you look for the source of the infestation [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a colossal egg in an abandoned cellar and crush it; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, the spiders grow more plentiful by the day; lose 2 Sanity.

You accidentally startle a man while he is whispering to something in the dirt. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you defeat it, you find a small spider crushed in the scuffle; gain this Clue. If you do not defeat it, he leaves you beaten and bloodied; gain 1 Injury Condition.

With a terrible roar, reality splits open just off the bow of the ship. You may gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition to take a closer look. If you gain the Condition, you see strands of the Spider-mother's web stitching together multiple dimensions; gain this Clue and 1 Spell.

A recently opened rift in space reacts to your presence. Strands of raw entropy affix themselves to your limbs as you draw near, offering you the limitless power of the Crawling Chaos. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and close 1 Gate of your choice on any space.

You come across a man who has been trapped in a giant spider web and try to free him [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, he tells you about the giant spider that ensnared him; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you manage only to slice your hand open on the razor-sharp silk; lose 2 Health.

A storm of shimmering rifts flicker in and out of being, and you try to navigate the ship around them [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you observe them knitting together; gain this Clue. If you fail, the ship passes directly through one and it overloads your senses; lose 1 Sanity and discard 1 Spell.

You try to understand the arcane power that is pulling reality closer to the Dreamlands [LORE - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you have at least 1 Spell. If you pass, you are able to understand the complexities of the process; gain this Clue. If you fail, it is a terrible strain on your mind; gain 1 Madness Condition.

You have precious little time and few options to deal with the degenerating pillars of reality. You plead with the gods of the Dreamlands for aid. Spawn 1 Gate unless you gain a Dark Pact Condition. If you gain the Condition, you are granted a brief vision of a possible future; gain this Clue.

A light breeze brings a swarm of thousands of tiny spiders sailing across the sea [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you note the northerly direction they are traveling; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, the ship sails right into them and several of them become stuck in your hair; lose 1 Sanity.

You attempt to decipher unusual writing scribbled in the margin of a dog-eared encyclopedia of arachnids [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you uncover writing about a web between worlds; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, reading the words aloud triggers an arcane ward; lose 2 Health.

Sightings of giant spiders have led you to explore a cave in the region [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find signs of a struggle and a corpse cocooned in silk; gain this Clue and 1 random Weapon Asset from the deck. If you fail, one of your friends disappears during the search; discard 1 Ally Asset.

You try to navigate through an unnatural storm, but it feels as if all the arcane power in your head is trying to escape [OBSERVATION + 1]; roll 1 fewer die for each Spell you have. If you pass, you think the storm was caused by a rift in space; gain this Clue. If you fail, the ship is nearly destroyed; become Delayed.

You feel the lightest of touches on your shoulder and spot a spider crawling toward your neck [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you deftly swat it and it releases a burst of arcane mist when it does; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, its bite siphons your life force into an arcane vortex; spawn 1 Gate.

You peer through a tear in the æther and think you can see hazy silhouettes weaving spider-like limbs to and fro. You will need to fully immerse yourself in the dark æther to observe any closer. You may gain a Cursed Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue and 1 Spell.

Without warning, one of the other passengers leaps on your back and tries to bite your exposed skin. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you defeat it, you find a jar of spiders on his person; gain this Clue. If you do not defeat it, his teeth leave deep marks in the flesh of your shoulder; lose 1 Health.

An arcane scholar doubts you possess the knowledge to comprehend his theory on the recent dimensional instability [INFLUENCE - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you have at least 1 Spell. If you pass, you convince him to share with you; gain this Clue. If you fail, his theory confuses you; lose 1 Sanity.

A swath of spiders appears to be marching toward some unknown destination [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you follow them and discover a slight tear in the fabric of reality; gain this Clue. If you fail, you disturb their march and they swarm up your leg; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

Giant spiders hang on invisible threads in the sky, dutifully weaving something you cannot see. You attempt to disrupt their task [LORE]. If you pass, you watch as they escape into another dimension; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, they manage to complete their work; spawn 1 Gate.

A young woman claims she is under the effects of a geas and is to present herself before the Mother of Spiders. You try to reason with her and break the curse [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, she overcomes her geas; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, she leaves, never to be seen again; advance Doom by 1.

You follow a set of unusual tracks through some rarely traveled areas of the countryside [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you follow the tracks to a den filled with massive spider egg sacs; gain this Clue. If you fail, you lose your way and spend several hours searching for the way back; become Delayed.

One of the other travelers belongs to the Spider Mother, but your source did not tell you who [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you keep close tabs on all of the other passengers; gain this Clue. If you fail, one of them opens a rift in secret, leaving you to handle it; spawn 1 Gate unless you discard 1 Spell.

The city is being overrun by giant spiders. You offer your assistance to the militia [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they arm you and tell you where the spiders are lurking; gain this Clue and 1 random Weapon Asset from the deck. If you fail, the spiders attack while the militia deliberate; lose 3 Health.

You come across a luminous silver thread suspended eerily in midair. You suspect that if you expended enough arcane energy you could open a rift large enough to get a look at the web the thread is attached to. You may discard 1 Spell to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You spend your time at sea honing your abilities. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You hardly notice the other passengers [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you notice a man with a robe entirely woven of gossamer; gain this Clue. If you fail, someone releases deadly spiders into your cabin; lose 3 Health.

You speak with a young woman who was attacked by giant spiders. She is distrustful of all things arcane and eyes you warily [INFLUENCE + 1]; roll 1 fewer die for each Spell you have. If you pass, she tells you about the attack; gain this Clue. If you fail, she has you arrested; gain a Detained Condition.

You observe a celestial phenomenon occurring in the night sky [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, another world blinks briefly into existence while you watch; gain this Clue. If you fail, your eyes grow heavy as you watching the dancing lights and you dream of other dimensions; gain 1 Madness Condition.

You search the heaps of charred bodies on a wrecked ship for anything useful [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find what you think is the source of the destruction; gain the Lightning Gun Artifact. If you fail, you find nothing and the smoking corpses make you retch; lose 2 Sanity.

A man in a pristine white suit offers you an ominous leather-bound tome. You need only sign his contract to acquire the book. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Necronomicon Artifact. If you do not gain the Condition, his eyes gleam with a frightening animosity; lose 2 Sanity.

You ask a dingy recluse to show you the latest addition to his insect collection [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he shows you a spider that is practically bursting with arcane energy; gain this Clue. If you fail, he launches into a maddeningly lengthy tirade about how spiders are not insects; lose 1 Sanity.

You feel something tiny inching up your leg and tear through your bedsheets in a panic [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a spider and smash it, leaving a spot of shining liquid in its place; gain this Clue. If you fail, it bites you and its venom warps your thoughts; lose 1 Sanity and discard 1 Spell.

You bump shoulders with a stranger as you walk along a quiet avenue [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you catch him trying to brush a spider onto you as he passes; gain this Clue. If you fail, you later come down with a fever that burns arcane energy from your mind; gain a Cursed Condition unless you discard 1 Spell.

You track of one of the Spider-mother's brood through a barren expanse [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you catch it trying to use a strange device to return to its faraway home; gain the Crux of Cykranosh Artifact. If you fail, the spider eludes you long enough to slip into another dimension; spawn 1 Gate.

The sailors have locked a giant spider in the hold, and it appears to be guarding something. They offer to let you in to study it, despite the danger [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you find that the spider was guarding a small dimensional tear; gain this Clue. If you fail, it defends itself viciously; lose 2 Health.

A pile of cobwebbed tomes proves useless when you find all of the pages to be empty. A tiny spider, fat with energy, has consumed the magic from the pages and appears to desire more. You may discard 1 Spell to gain this Clue. If you do not discard the Spell, the spider bites you; lose 1 Health.

The venom from a spider bite warps your memory. You struggle to remain in control in the face of disturbing visions [WILL]. If you pass, you overcome the venom and the experience makes you stronger; gain this Clue and improve [STRENGTH]. If you fail, the visions stay with you; gain 2 Madness Conditions.

A padlocked chest in the Captain's quarters thumps and shakes as if something inside is trying to escape. You attempt to pick the lock [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find only an innocuous book within; gain the T'tka Halot Artifact. If you fail, the Captain catches you in the act; gain a Detained Condition.

You spot a deadly spider crawling up a stranger's shoulder and attempt to swat it [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you are thanked profusely for your life-saving heroics; gain 1 Character Unique Asset. If you fail, the spider grows suddenly to a gargantuan size; a Leng Spider Monster ambushes you!

You search for the inhabitants of a quiet farm [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find numerous giant spider corpses around the body of a single farmer, still clutching his weapon; gain this Clue and 1 random Weapon Asset from the deck. If you fail, you do not notice the furiously weaving spiders nearby; spawn 1 Gate.

Fog makes it difficult to spot the place from your vision, forcing you to rely on intuition [OBSERVATION - 1]; roll 2 additional dice if you have at least 1 Spell. If you pass, you find a rift over the water; gain this Clue. If you fail, you begin to think your visions were lies; gain 1 Madness Condition.

A man attacks you without warning as you enter a dark alleyway. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you defeat it, you take note of his gossamer cloak as he flees; gain this Clue. If you do not defeat it, the man siphons arcane energy from your unconscious body; lose 1 Sanity and discard 1 Spell.

You focus your thoughts, attuning yourself to the silver strands that bind the cosmos together [WILL]. If you pass, you need only reach out to pluck one of the strings; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, you lose yourself among the stars; lose 2 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

In a moment of clarity, a decrepit mariner claims to have been a thrall of the Spider-mother for most of his life. You ask him what he knows [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he teaches you some of the things he learned; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, his mind is too far gone; advance Doom by 1.

Peering through translucent cobblestones, you can see a sea of stars beneath. You study the strange phenomenon [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you realize it is a projection of the Spider-mother's lair; gain this Clue. If you fail, your meddling opens a path; advance Doom by 1 unless you discard 1 Spell.

Thunder cracks through the air, but there are no storm clouds [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you deftly avoid a rift as it opens before you; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you are swallowed by a rift and fall into the Spider-mother's web; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

You recall the knowledge needed to divert energy generated by deep-sea currents to flood an entrance to the Spider-mother's web [LORE]. If you pass, the floundering Leng spiders sever the path; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, the power overwhelms you; lose 3 Sanity.

You hear bouts of heated yelling and follow the ruckus [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you arrive just in time to stop a strange man from feeding spider venom to his victim; gain this Clue and 1 random Ally Asset from the deck. If you fail, there is a blood-curdling scream and the yelling stops; lose 1 Sanity.

You siphon arcane power from the space between dimensions to learn about the other side [LORE]. If you pass, you glimpse a verdant alien forest in the land of dreams; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, you see only ruin and devastation; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

The Spider-mother is drawing another research vessel into a dimensional vortex. You take careful aim and toss them a towing line [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you are able to slowly pull them out; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, your ship is drawn in as well; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

The police have killed one of the giant spiders and allow you to dissect it [LORE]. If you pass, you discover how the Leng spiders are able to bridge dimensions; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, you mistakenly pierce an unknown gland, splashing yourself with corrosive venom; lose 2 Health.

You stumble upon a pair of Leng spiders orbiting around another, puncturing the space between dimensions and threading it with strands of glowing gossamer. Gain this Clue. You try to edge away before they notice [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, they pursue you for hours; become Delayed.

You are convinced that ingesting a small amount of venom will make you stronger [WILL - 1]. If you pass, after a period of brief sickness, you feel strengthened by the poison; gain this Clue and improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, one of your friends slips into a coma from the poison; discard 1 Ally Asset.

A young girl has fallen into a rift. You dive through in an attempt to save her [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find her and bring her back; gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you never find the girl, and the inky darkness of the dimensional rift seeps into your core; gain 1 Bane Condition.

You immerse yourself in the space between dimensions in order to spy on the Spider-mother's brood [LORE]. If you pass, you observe many spiders as they traverse their mother's web; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, the warped dimension takes a toll on your body; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

Once-familiar seas have mysteriously changed, as if you have mistakenly sailed into the seas of another world. Gain this Clue. The confused sailors ask for your help navigating the unfamiliar waters [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, you lead the sailors astray for several days; become Delayed.

Someone sends you a translation of an ancient Hyperborean text. Gain this Clue. You try to deduce who sent it [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you locate the sender and your perseverance earns you a new friend; gain 1 random Ally Asset from the deck. If you fail, not knowing drives you mad; lose 2 Sanity.

You use your knowledge of the ley lines to search for a place where the Spider-mother's web is close to emerging [LORE]. If you pass, you find a portion of the Dreamlands that has bled into reality; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, you end up lost and confused; lose 1 Sanity and become Delayed.

Someone has released hundreds of thousands of small spiders onto the ship. You attempt to capture some for study [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you gather the specimens in a mason jar; gain this Clue. If you fail, the spiders elude you but you wake the next day covered in spider bites; lose 2 Health.

You fixate on aligning yourself with the shifting axis of power surrounding the Spider-mother's web [WILL]. If you pass, you become attuned; gain this Clue and improve [LORE]. If you fail, you disjoin yourself from the locus of energy, splintering your psyche; gain 2 Madness Conditions.

You find several hapless men strung up in cocoons and held in place by razor-sharp webbing. Gain this Clue. You try to free them from captivity [STRENGTH - 1]. If you fail, the webbing proves stronger than you expected and you cut yourself many times while freeing the men; lose 2 Health.

Proximity to the ethereal strands of the Spider-mother's web is disrupting the natural flow of arcane energy. If you have no Spells, you make note of the phenomenon; gain this Clue. If you have at least 1 Spell, your mind becomes a convoluted jumble; gain 1 Madness Condition.

A rift opens in a crowded square, and grasping spider legs reach out into the crowd. You try to tackle its target out of the way [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, knowledge is offered as thanks; gain this Clue and 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, the spider pulls one of your friends into the rift; discard 1 Ally Asset.

An earsplitting screech nearly deafens you. A Leng Spider Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [WILL] test, you learn much by observing it during the struggle; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail the [WILL] test, it catches you off guard and knocks you to the ground; gain 1 Injury Condition.

As the sun rises, you find to your dismay that the sails have been covered with sticky spider webs. Gain this Clue. You try to maintain your balance as you climb the mast to clear away the webs [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, you fall from your perch, hurting yourself badly; gain 2 Injury Conditions.

You overhear a distraught hotel manager complaining that giant spiders have infested the hotel basement. Gain this Clue. You offer to help clear them out for free [STRENGTH - 1]. If you fail, he later finds you bloody and beaten in a pile of spider corpses, lose 1 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

An unfortunate victim is caught in a massive spider web, screaming for help. You think you can perform a successful rescue, but stealing away the spider's meal may drive them into a ravenous frenzy. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 random Ally Asset from deck.

An unsettling passenger with a pet tarantula offers to teach you the secret of taming spiders [LORE]. If you pass, you learn to manipulate the minds of spiders; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, you realize too late that it is you who is being manipulated; gain 1 Madness Condition.

You wake to a squat, bloated spider hanging above your bed. If you have at least 1 Spell, she communicates telepathically that has broken free of Atlach-Nacha's brood; gain this Clue. If you have no Spells, you immediately pack your things and leave the horrible hotel; lose 1 Sanity.

You study the effect of arcane energy on spiders in the wild. Gain this Clue. The experiment draws the attention of the spiders' larger cousins [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you continue to observe in secret; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you give yourself away and the experiment is ruined; lose 1 Sanity.

You find a colony of Leng spiders on a desert island. A Leng Spider ambushes you! If you pass the [WILL] test, you notice a pattern in their movements; gain this Clue. If you fail the [WILL] test, you hesitate and it incapacitates you, wrapping you in a sticky cocoon; become Delayed.

A giant spider is so bloated with magical energy that it can hardly move. You try to siphon some of the magic while it struggles to escape [LORE]. If you pass, you steal some of its power; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, it lashes out at you as it skitters away; gain 1 Injury Condition.

A rift propels you through time to mankind's end. You take up the arms of a fallen hero. Gain 1 Weapon Artifact. The Spider-mother herself bears down upon you. The Atlach-Nacha Epic Monster ambushes you! If you defeat it, the Spider-mother is weakened; gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1.

Unbeknown to you, several giant spiders were being transported in the cargo hold. Now, the frenzied spiders have broken free and are hunting passengers. Gain this Clue. You try to hide [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, they find you and you are badly hurt fending them off; gain 1 Injury Condition.

You stare into the bright waters of a shimmering pool and see a reflection of yourself back in the waking world. Resolve the pass effect to see what lies beneath the surface; or resolve the fail effect to converse with your reflection about the state of the world.

You sense the pool is a living thing, and you try to communicate with it [LORE - 1]. If you pass, it understands you and offers a gift that was lost within its depths; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, it calls for help; a Zoog Monster ambushes you!

Your reflection winks at you, and you initiate a conversation [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, the other you repairs a tear in reality; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, the reflection steals aspects of your persona; discard 1 Talent Condition.

You see three stunningly beautiful individuals some distance off the path. They are sitting around a large stone table drinking wine, and you feel compelled to join them despite your better judgment [WILL - 1].

You force yourself to look away, examining the ground instead [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you see a treasure discarded by some lost dreamer; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, keeping your eyes pointed down slows your progress; become Delayed.

These three seem to follow very obscure rules of etiquette [LORE]. If you pass, they reward your manners and send you on your way; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, your rudeness is punished; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.
A zoog cautiously approaches you. Using what little knowledge of the creature's language you possess, you ask permission to speak to the Council of Zoogs [LORE - 1].

The Council of Zoogs agrees to help you. Close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. The zoogs seem to be trying to keep you distracted [WILL]. If you fail, you wake up in the forest missing important memories; gain an Amnesia Condition and discard 1 Clue.

The zoog runs away. You chase it, passing portals to other worlds [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you see one that is familiar; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, you stumble through a portal; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.
You watch carefully to see which mushrooms the zoogs eat. Desperate for food, you sample some of them, but find that their effects make it difficult to keep your thoughts in order [WILL - 1].

Your mind is subtly altered by the mushrooms. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You now see arcane symbols in the forest [LORE - 1]. If you pass, they lead you to a treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you wander the forest in a stupor; lose 2 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

Strange illusions pass before your eyes [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the images prove instructive; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you see no difference between lunacy and destiny; gain 3 Madness Conditions unless you advance the Omen by 1.
A zoog has gotten itself stuck in the frame of a large stone door embedded into the floor of the forest. You try to open the door enough for the zoog to get free [STRENGTH - 1].

The stone door shifts, and a strange mist emerges, altering your mind. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You ask the zoog for help [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, it shares what it knows; gain 1 Task Unique Asset. If you fail, it attacks; a Zoog Monster ambushes you!

An enormous arm pulls the zoog through the opening. Lose 1 Sanity. You briefly see the Symbol of Koth beyond the door [WILL]. If you pass, a new part of your mind is unlocked; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, pain overwhelms you; lose 2 Health.

In one of the moon's shadowy forests, a moon-beast has you cornered. Resolve the pass effect to pray to Nodens to bestow a gift; or resolve the fail effect to banish the creature to another dimension.

A nightgaunt descends and scoops you into the sky. You find it difficult to navigate while riding this strange creature [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you land next to a rare treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you become hopelessly lost; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.
A Moon-beast Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [WILL] test, it is momentarily confused and you order it to obey you in the name of Nyarlathotep; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space.
You follow a dark winding cavern down to the inky black waters known as the Lake of Ubboth. There you recite an ancient chant to invoke the power of Mnomquah [LORE].

The tremendous lizard-like creature emerges from the water. It is terrible to behold [WILL]. If you pass, it grant you a favor; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the monstrous sight shatters your mind; gain 1 Madness Condition.

The Lord of the Black Lake does not appear, but the cavern begins to collapse [STRENGTH]. If you pass, the tremors uncover a treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the falling stones leave you badly hurt; lose 2 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.
You find a hidden shrine to Azathoth, whose worship is strictly forbidden among the moon-beasts and is punishable by death. You believe you can use the altar to enact a powerful ritual [LORE - 1].

You invoke Azathoth to close a bridge between worlds. Close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. The outer god's power begins to drive you to self-destruction [WILL - 1]. If you fail, you carve ritualistic symbols into your flesh; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

You report the shrine to the men of Leng [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they reward your diligence; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, they do not believe you, and strip you of your belongings as punishment for lying; discard 2 Item possessions.
You have found your way into the Tower of Nyarlathotep. The unsettling knowledge that the Crawling Chaos himself lurks somewhere in these halls shakes your resolve [WILL - 1].

The tower contains books on every topic. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You discern an occult pattern to the layout of the tower [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you find your way to the top; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you find yourself outside; a Moon-beast Monster ambushes you!

You search desperately for an exit [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you escape with alien voices in your head; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, Nyarlathotep finds you and offers to spare your mind for a price; lose 2 Sanity unless you spawn 1 Gate.

An enormous black galley sails across the dark sky and eventually comes to rest in the Great Lunar Sea. The men of Leng use these ships to transport their cargo. You attempt to sneak on board the ship [OBSERVATION - 1].

You find strange rubies that whisper secrets. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You ask a guard to unlock the ship's safe [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you find a map; gain 1 Task Unique Asset. If you fail, the guard demands a bribe; discard 1 Item possession.

You are forced to hide next to a corpse. Lose 1 Sanity. The dead man left behind an encrypted journal [LORE]. If you pass, you have an epiphany while reading the unusual text; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, the journal becomes red-hot and burns you; lose 1 Health.
You hear the familiar voice of a friend calling to you from the darkness. Resolve the pass effect to go toward the sound; or resolve the fail effect to convince the person to come to you.

The voice draws you into the Vale of Pnath [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you see that your friend is now a ghoul, but he offers you a gift; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you are paralyzed with fear as a dhole devours your friends; lose 1 Sanity and discard 1 Ally Asset.

You call out through the darkness [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you see he is now a ghoul but he can help you; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, your friend tells you horrors that shake you to your core; lose 2 Sanity unless you discard 1 Talent Condition.
As you ascend the Peaks of Thok, you hear gurgling voices ahead of you. You are certain that there are ghouls nearby and it takes all of your resolve to keep moving forward [WILL].

A decrepit form lunges toward you. A Ghoul Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [STRENGTH] test, you steal an object that the ghoul kept in a moldy canvas bag; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail the [STRENGTH] test, the ghoul claims a nearby victim; discard 1 Ally Asset.

You descend into the Vale of Pnath. Among the bones and refuse you determine what might be of worth [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you find a treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you should not have disturbed these remains; gain 1 Bane Condition.

You are surrounded by gugs. The monstrous giants will most certainly kill you if you cannot get help. Desperate to escape, you hope that Nodens' servants will respond to your mystic summons [LORE - 1].

A nightgaunt flies you away and helps you fix the tears in reality. Close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. The flight through the cosmos overwhelms your mind [WILL]. If you fail, you pass out; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

The abyssal creature heeds your call. A Nightgaunt Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [STRENGTH] test, you climb onto it and fly away; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail the [STRENGTH] test, you never fully recover; discard all of your Improvement tokens.
The Vaults of Zin are a winding maze of tunnels. The endless twists and turns, as well as the constant attacks by ghasts, push you to the brink of complete and utter despair [WILL - 1].

The ordeal has made you stronger. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You attempt to follow a map [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you find a rare treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the ghasts leave you bleeding; lose 2 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

Your mind is slipping. Gain 1 Madness Condition. You try to capture a lost ghoul [STRENGTH]. If you pass, it tells you what you want to know; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, it warns the entire Underworld about you; advance Doom by 1.
You walk among a series of strange monoliths, a graveyard for the creature who were the forebears of the gugs. You try to decipher the strange symbols and images carved into the stone [LORE - 1].

The carvings open your mind to a new way of thinking. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You leave a small offering [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, a panel in the stone opens, revealing a map; gain 1 Task Unique Asset. If you fail, the earth begins to shake; lose 2 Sanity.

The stones are abhorrent to look at. Lose 1 Sanity. You see a ghoul living among the stones [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you can imitate its expertise; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you watch until the ghoul devours a carcass; lose 2 Sanity.

The great god Karakal will hear your plea only if you cross the stones that burn eternally. Resolve the pass effect to leap across the lava; or resolve the fail effect to harness the magical power of Kadath.

You leap as far as you can [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you land safely on the other side and the god rewards you; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you fall short and suffer grievous wounds; gain 2 Injury Conditions.

The room crackles with arcane energy [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you magically appear on the other side and the god rewards you; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, you simply vanish; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.
You invoke the power of those who dwell beyond Kadath. After employing the necessary angles and formulae you call forth those who dwell in Yr and Nhhngr. Their forms are truly repulsive [WILL].

Once summoned, these beings must be bound [LORE]. If you pass, they grant you the help you seek; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, your bindings fail and they punish you for your impudence; lose 2 Health.

Helpless, you beg for mercy [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, they accept your abasement and reward it; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, these horrors give you an ultimatum; lose 2 Health and 2 Sanity unless you gain a Dark Pact Condition.
In the Cold Waste, you find a band of explorers convinced that they are in the Antarctic. You believe there is some magic in the area that can be used to manipulate time and space [LORE - 1].

You return the men home and seal a breach between worlds. Close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. Using such power requires a strong mind [WILL]. If you fail, it takes a terrible toll; gain 1 Injury Condition and 1 Madness Condition.

You try to retrace the men's path [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find the doorway and seal it after the men return to Earth; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, your soul is scarred by the death of the men; gain 1 Bane Condition.
Armed servants surround a man in pharaoh's garb on all sides. Regal and terrifying, the man cries out "Bow down to me!" You feel compelled to do so along with his followers [WILL - 1].

You escape into the castle and find books that enhance your abilities. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You suspect there is a secret chamber [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you find it; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you are caught; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

As you kneel, the servant Yogash challenges you to combat [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you are rewarded; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, you beg for mercy; lose 3 Health unless you gain a Dark Pact Condition.
Desperate for water, you drink deeply from the Fountain of Alath-Zann. The surface of the water begins to show you images of potential futures, including truly horrific possibilities [WILL - 1].

You foresee learning new abilities. Gain 1 Talent Condition. You toss coins into the water [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you see a worthy future; gain 1 Task Unique Asset. If you fail, you foresee losing an important book; lose 1 Sanity and discard 1 Tome possession.

Gain 1 Madness Condition. You irrationally lunge into the water, almost drowning [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you emerge with the wisdom of your own future; gain 1 Talent Condition. If you fail, your splashing attracts attention; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

Your enjoyment of a lovely afternoon stroll through the park is cut tragically short as water begins to seep up from the ground around your ankles. The water is rising at an alarming rate and by the time it reaches your shoulder you begin to feel pangs of panic in the pit of your stomach [WILL - 1].

Finding that you are unable to wake, you instead perform a hasty ritual that will allow you to breathe underwater [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the water eventually ceases trying to drown you and you wake soaked from head to toe; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, there is scarcely enough oxygen to stay conscious; gain 1 Madness Condition.

You cough and sputter as water fills your lungs. Lose 2 Health. You try to desperately to swim to the surface, but the current is pulling you under [STRENGTH - 1]. if you fail, you body is pushed beyond its limits in your desperation to stay alive; gain 1 Injury Condition.

You do not recall falling asleep, but you are convinced beyond a shadow of a doubt that what you are seeing cannot be reality. The sky has turned blood-red, and a river of dark, crimson liquid flows toward the horizon. You attempt to discern the source of the nightmare [LORE - 1].

You sense a disturbance in the folds of reality and follow the river to a crimson delta. You spot an ashen statue protruding from the swampy muck and summon your courage to wade up to it [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you topple the statue and the dream with it; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, the aroma of blood sickens you to your core; lose 1 Sanity.

You wander for what feels like a lifetime among the forks of the crimson river, but there is not another soul to be seen. Lose 1 Sanity. Fatigue takes root within your body but you try to carry on [STRENGTH]. if you fail, you collapse from sheer exhaustion; lose 2 Health.

A raging inferno blazes around you, swallowing the home of your childhood in a pillar of fire. Though your ears hear only crackling flame, distance screams and pleas for help reverberate within your mind, and you struggle against the urge to dash into the burning house [WILL - 1].

Distancing yourself mentally from the horrific scene, you focus on the words of an incantation that will allow you to control the events of your dream [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the fire flickers and dies; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, the sinister flames grow only larger as all that you once knew is reduced to a smoldering pile of ash; lose 2 Sanity.

The ravenous flames lick at your heels as you enter the smoke-filled house, and some of your belongings catch fire. Discard 1 Item possession. The house starts to collapse, and you know you must leave [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, you are struck by falling debris; lose 2 Health.

You stand upon a rocky bluff amongst a small gathering of unfamiliar faces. You spot one of your companions nearby and realize that this must not be your dream. Your coat flaps wildly as the wind begins to pick up, and you plead with your friend to move away from the cliff edge [INFLUENCE - 1].

The wind continues to pick up speed, and before long, it is all you can do to remain standing. You direct the flow of æther in the dream to calm the storm [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the storm dissipates and the dream ends; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. if you fail, the stinging winds rend the skin on your arms and face; lose 2 health.

A sudden gust of wind knocks your friend off balance, and in an instant, the dream is ended. Discard 1 Ally Asset. You reason with yourself that you did all that you could [WILL]. If you fail, you blame yourself; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

You are standing in line at the bank, waiting for the teller to become available. Finally, you are next in queue, but the elderly woman just ahead of you seems to be causing a delay. Peering around her, you are enraged to see her counting pennies one at a time out of giant sack [WILL - 1].

You tap the woman on the shoulder and politely ask if you may make a quick deposit [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, she happily agrees and shares her raisins with you before you leave; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, she writhes and twists as she transforms into a hideous abomination, slashing you with her grotesque claws; lose 2 Health.

The absurdity is too much! Gain 1 Madness Condition. You realize with sudden clarity that you are surrounded not by bank patrons, but by ghouls. You try to ward the ghouls away [LORE - 1]. If you fail, they tear at your flesh; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

The sound of chanting fills your soul with indescribable dread, and you realize with horror that the voice of the chanter is your own. Your limbs move against your will, performing the somatic portion of the abhorrent summoning. You focus your energy on wresting control of your body [WILL - 1].

You work quickly to undo the magic that has already begun to bridge some unknown dimension with your dream [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the summoning is ended; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, a shadow of what lies upon the other side of the threshold slips into your mind before your work is finished; gain 1 Madness Condition.

Unable to stop, you spill your own blood as a catalyst, bringing the horrific thing into being. Lose 1 Health. The pain returns you to normal, and you try to evade the beast [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, it maims you; gain 1 Injury and 1 Madness Condition.

The skinless visage of a disembodied head manifests before you as you drift through a sea of æther. It whispers softly to you, insisting that the only way to save the world is to leave it. A pedestal appears before you, upon which lies a simple silver dagger, and you fight the urge to touch it [WILL - 1].

You lunge away from the face instead, and its exposed muscles tighten as it shrieks in rage. You scan the murky æther for a way to escape [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a tear in the æther and slip through; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, the face jinxes you to appear in its likeness and the skin on your face begins to flake and peel away; lose 1 Sanity.

Before you can stop yourself, you grab the dagger and plunge it into your body. Gain 1 Injury Condition. Jolting awake, you quickly attempt to bandage the wound [LORE]. If you fail, you lose a worrisome amount of blood as you fumble about; lose 2 Health.

As you lie in your bed, teetering between sleep and wakefulness, you realize suddenly that your body is completely immobilized. You are struck by the sensation of someone standing next to your bed, watching you, but you rationalize with yourself that this could not be the case [LORE - 1].

Reason overcomes fear, and as the terror passes, you call upon every fiber of your being to fight against the paralysis [WILL]. If you pass, you jolt upright in your bed, sweating profusely; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, you slip further and further into a sea of luminous black shapes, all the while remaining wholly unable to move; lose 1 Sanity.

As you panic, the dream gives form to your fear, but you remain unable to move. Lose 1 Sanity. You plead with the manifestation to leave you in peace [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you fail, the dark phantom tortures you while you lie helpless; lose 2 Health.

You find yourself seated in a magnificent stadium amongst a cheering crowd. Below you, gladiators are gathering for the opening ceremony, the dreamer amongst them. Resolve the pass effect to enter the competition; or resolve the fail effect to reason with the dreamer.

When it comes time to face the dreamer, you find him to be a skilled and dangerous adversary, if only in his dreams [STRENGTH - 1]. if you pass, you manage to subdue him without harming him, and the stadium dissolves around you; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, he wounds you severely; lose 1 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

He listens to your explanation, though he does not wish to believe it [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, disappointment is clear on his face and the dream dissipates; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, he directs the crowd to remove you; lose 2 Health.

You peer through a cottage window and see the dreamer at a table with his family, sharing a meal, smiling and laughing together in familiar comfort. Resolve the pass effect to join them at the table; or resolve the fail effect to leave them be and exert your own power to end the dream.

You eat supper with the happy family, but when it is over, you pull the dreamer aside [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you discover that his family passed away long ago and that he had simply wanted to spend an evening with them; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, the dreamer ejects you forcefully from his delusion; gain a Lost in Time and Space Condition.

You focus on dispelling the illusion [WILL - 1]. If you pass, the dream ceases to be; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, the dream becomes hellish and gaping maw devours the family as they dine; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

You manifest on the perimeter of a peaceful, golden field where a young woman is picking flowers. She becomes suddenly alert, and you realize with surprise that she must have sensed your arrival. Resolve the pass effect to try to conceal yourself; or resolve the fail effect to greet her.

You dive into the tall wheat and try to remain still [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, the woman goes about her business and you are able to get close enough to startle her out of the dream; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, she spots you and turns the dream against you, causing the field of wheat to transform into a pit of striking serpents; lose 2 Health.

You smile and wave [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, she tells you that she has always been able to control her dreams and leaves; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, you are forcefully ejected from her dream; gain 2 Madness Conditions.

The dreamer is perched atop a gilded velvet throne, ordering servants to and fro at the slightest whim. Resolve the pass effect come before him as his subject and open a petition; or resolve the fail effect to go to the kitchens and concoct a debilitating poison to slip into his next meal.

The dreamer listens to your plea to end the dream with bemusement [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he removes his crown and steps down from the throne, gazing one final time across the palace grounds as the dream unravels around him; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, he orders you to be thrown into the dungeon and tortured; lose 2 Health.

You try to mix a poison of the proper potency [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the dreamer passes out after the first bite and the dream ends; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, the dream becomes a nightmarish fever dream; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

Lifting a creaky wooden hatch, you find yourself descending into a dusty but neatly organized laboratory where a middle-aged man is diligently mixing several neon-colored liquids. Resolve the pass effect to pose as his lab assistant; or resolve the fail effect to appeal to his sense of reason.

As you approach, the dreamer demands that you hand him a particular vial [LORE - 1]. If you pass, he seems satisfied with your selection and you hit him over the head as he returns to his work; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, he accuses you of being an intruder and throws a fiery glowing liquid in your face, igniting your flesh; lose 2 Health.

You explain that the laboratory is but a dream [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, the man agrees, noting that he has no idea what he is doing; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, he tells you the one who is dreaming is you; gain 2 Madness Conditions.

You narrowly avoid being stepped on as the gargantuan dreamer gleefully stomps on village houses, sending tiny people fleeing in every direction. Resolve the pass effect to attempt to climb the dreamer; or resolve the fail effect to try to return yourself to your actual height.

You spot a ledge from which you might be able to leap onto the dreamer's coat [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you climb the coat to the dreamer's head and stab him in the eye, bringing the dream to an end; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, you plummet to the ground, hitting several protruding outcroppings as you fall; lose 1 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

You recall the words that will return you to your normal size [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you become large again and subdue the surprisingly diminutive dreamer; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, your body contorts painfully; lose 2 Health.

You enter the dream in the depths of a dark and quiet forest, but the dreamer is nowhere to be seen. You spot a leg-hold trap, and your stomach sinks as you realize that you are being hunted. Resolve the pass effect to use magic to gain the upper hand; or resolve the fail effect to confront the huntress directly.

You perform a ritual to send a warning to the huntress [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you are able to impart a message to her before she finds you and she begrudgingly brings the dream to an end; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, the arcane energy fizzles and gives you away, making you an easy target for her rifle; lose 1 Health and gain 1 Injury Condition.

You run headfast into the huntress, and for a brief moment she is startled [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you manage to tackle her before she shoots; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, you scramble away and she pursues you for hours; become Delayed.

The dreamer sits before you in a blood-red dress, comfortably leaning against one arm of a large armchair and smoking a cigarette. You are struck by a sense of imminent danger. Resolve the pass effect to gird yourself for an attack; or resolve the fail effect to conjure up an improvised ward.

The dream beings to bend and tear, nightmares pouring in from every crack as the dreamer begins her assault [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you weather the onslaught and wrest control of the nightmares, turning them against her; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, she breaks you and steals a piece of your mind; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 Madness Condition.

You hastily speak the arcane words [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you reflect the dreamer's witchcraft, incapacitating her and ending the dream; place this Clue on the active Mystery. If you fail, your insides crack and rupture as she hexes you; gain 2 Injury Conditions.

The Lord of Sleep appears before you, drawing back the hood of his cloak to reveal black, soulless eyes. Unable to look away, you feel your mind begin to overflow with the dreams of all humanity, both pleasant and nightmarish. You make one desperate attempt to shut them out [WILL - 1].

The visions dissipate, but your relief is only temporary. The Lord of Sleep reaches out and grabs you with a stone-like grip [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you fight tooth and nail for your survival; you may discard 1 Talent Condition to place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. If you fail or do not discard the Condition, he feasts upon your life force; lose 3 Health.
You recoil from the psychological deluge, tripping over yourself as you scramble to withdraw from your own mind, but there is no escape from the boundless void of dreams. You are devoured.

Your heart sinks as you sense the quickly approaching presence of the once-benign Lord of Sleep. You hurriedly flip through the pages of the forbidden tome, hands trembling with fear as you scan the faded volume for the incantation that you can only hope will save your life [OBSERVATION - 1].

You find what you are looking for and begin your preparations [LORE - 1]; you may spend any number of Clues to add 1 success to your test result for each Clue spent. if your test result is 3 or greater, the atmosphere ripples as you shatter Hypnos' hold on your dreams; place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. Otherwise, the magic backfires; lose 3 Sanity.
Soon, an oppressive silence fills the room. As the inky blackness of space coils around your neck, you calmly close the book and put it neatly back where you found it. You are devoured.

In the skies above, the Corona Borealis shines its red-gold light upon the Dreamlands through ever-widening cracks in time and space. The light feels somehow gentle, and your eyes grow heavy but you tell yourself that you must not sleep. You must remain alert to face your foe [WILL - 1].

The Lord of Sleep manifests before you, the myriad stars of his domain swirling around him, his mere presence draining years of your life [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, the sheer power of your inner strength rebuffs him; you may spend 3 Health to place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. If you fail or do not spend the Health, gain a Cursed Condition.
You close your eyes and slip away into the cold embrace of sleep. The Corona Borealis flares red, and all that you ever were becomes but a passing dream. You are devoured.

With a brilliant flash and a resounding crack, the atmosphere is torn asunder, and you find yourself being drawn into a thundering singularity. Staring into the gaping breach, you see a sliver of suspended earth on the other side and attempt to propel yourself toward it [OBSERVATION - 1].

You scramble to your feet on the floating landmass and find yourself gazing into the eyes of the Lord of Sleep [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you turn your mental acuity against him; you may spend 3 Sanity to place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. if you fail or do not spend the Sanity, he pushes you into the star-filled void; resolve the fail effect.
You struggle to breathe as you are pulled into the vast emptiness. You reach out to any power that will listen to save you. Gain a Dark Pact Condition and 2 Talent Conditions.

Face to face with the hooded being, you are taken aback to see that it is not the Master of Dreams. If you have a Dark Pact Condition, you realize with a cold certainty that you have come to the end; you are devoured. The being offers you the power to fight if you can sustain it [LORE - 1].

You confront the Lord of Sleep and attempt to make use of your newfound power [WILL - 1]; you may spend up to 3 Health and up to 3 Sanity to roll 1 additional die for each Health or Sanity spent. If your test result is 3 or greater, the influence of the Corona Borealis wanes; place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. Otherwise, resolve the fail effect.
The power proves to be far greater than you can control, and it leaves your mind scraped clean of your happy memories. Gain a Cursed Condition and an Amnesia Condition.

The Lord of Sleep, adorned with a wreath of laurels, presents himself to you. He gestures, opening the way to eternity, paving the path with the red-gold light of Corona Borealis. You draw every ounce of your arcane ability and attempt to redirect the flow of energy [LORE - 1].

Intrigued by your will to live, the Lord of Sleep entreats you to prove your worth [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he offers you passage back to the dreamlands in exchange for your memories; you may discard 1 Task Asset to place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. If you fail or do not discard the Asset, he throws you into the void; resolve the fail effect.
The shimmering path grows bright, illuminating the horrors beyond. Spawn 1 Gate unless you gain a Dark Pact Condition. If you spawn the Gate, move to that space.

A blanket of red and gold stars stretches across the sky above the Dreamlands. All who reside beneath them fall under the sway of a gentle, pulsing lullaby. You feel the Dreamlands being drained of all color and light and try to resist becoming entranced [WILL - 1].

You attempt a ritual that would return the alien stars to whence they came, but it will consume part of your soul [LORE - 1]; you may discard any number of Talent Conditions to add 1 success to your test result for each Condition discarded. If your test result is 3 or greater, you banish the stars; place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. if you fail, resolve the fail effect.
The calamitous starlight continues to feed on the vitality of the Dreamlands. Each investigator on this space loses 1 Sanity. Shuffle the Dream-Quest Encounter deck.

Nodens, Great Lord of the Abyss, sends his nightgaunts to bring you to his abysmal abode. Wishing nothing less than to retake the Dreamlands and rule over its many cities, he teaches you a powerful incantation that will summon him in a time of great need [LORE - 1].

Faced with confronting Hypnos, the Lord of Sleep, you call upon Nodens to grant you a mighty boon, but you ask for more than he is willing to give [INFLUENCE - 1]; you may gain a Dark Pact Condition to roll 3 additional dice. If your test result is 3 or greater, he acquiesces; place 1 Eldritch token on the Ancient One sheet. Otherwise, resolve the fail effect.
Displeased with your ineptitude, Nodens banishes you from his sight. Each investigator on this space moves to a random space unless he spends 1 Clue.

You find an odd object at the ruined Whateley farm. Gain 1 random MAGICAL Asset from the deck. Shredded notes litter the site [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you decode an arcane formula from the scraps; gain 1 INCANTATION Spell. If you fail, the writing is gibberish; lose 1 Sanity.

Herbert Fleishhacker arranges specialized training for you. Gain 1 TALENT Condition. You ask him about the 1906 earthquake [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he explains how animals predict disasters; improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, the stories traumatize you; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

A member of the Lautaro Lodge tells you about their arcane studies. Gain 1 RITUAL Spell. You ask to join them [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, you are inducted with a gift; gain 1 random TRINKET Asset from the deck. If you fail, you must pay a fee; gain 1 Debt Condition.

A sailor at the Rope and Anchor in Kingsport provides his help. Gain 1 non-RITUAL Spell. You offer what pay you can [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he thanks you; gain 1 random MAGICAL Asset from the deck. If you fail, he mutters arcane words that disturb you; lose 2 Sanity.

The Cliff House has been closed down, but you may know a way to commune with a ghost that haunts the famous restaurant and discover the secrets of the dead. You may spend 1 Clue to improve [OBSERVATION] and gain 1 TALENT Condition.

After the floodwater subsides, the deluge has left behind strange books and curios, though searching for something worthwhile would be time-consuming. You may become Delayed to gain 1 RITUAL Spell and 1 random TRINKET Asset from the deck.

You try to convince the manager of the First Bank of Arkham to give you access to a particular safety deposit box [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you find a legendary treasure; gain 1 MAGICAL Artifact. If you fail, the manager calls over a security guard; gain a Detained Condition.

Your search leads you to an abandoned temple of Cthugha. The profane altar abruptly catches fire [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you find journals that describe how the cultists stay hidden; improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, the smoke and flames overwhelm you; lose 1 Health.

The Santa Rosa storm threatens to flood the city. You try to get those trapped by the waters to safety [STRENGTH]. If you pass, an elderly man rewards your heroism; gain 1 random TRINKET Asset from the deck. If you fail, the flooding nearly drowns you; lose 1 Health.

They say that strange creatures perform ancient rituals on Devil Reef off the coast of Innsmouth, but to witness them, you have to know when to go and where to hide. You may spend 1 Clue to gain 1 INCANTATION Spell and 1 non-RITUAL Spell.

From deep below the ground, a cthonian contacts you telepathically [WILL - 1]. If you pass, its meddling unlocks parts of your mind and you resist its dark commands; improve 1 skill of your choice and gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, your mind snaps before the invading presence; lose 1 Sanity.

You try to interpret the legend of a hidden statue that calms storms [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you find the object in a small church and it grants you immense arcane power; gain 1 RITUAL Spell and 1 non-INCANTATION Spell. If you fail, you dream of dying in a typhoon; lose 1 Sanity.

A seminar from a visiting professor reveals dark truths. Spawn 1 Clue. You try to meet with him [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he is pleased to speak with you and asks for help; gain the Professor Morgan Unique Asset. If you fail, he thinks you mean him harm and attacks you; lose 2 Health.

Men from Naples ask you to interpret ancient objects that they pulled from a city beneath the waves [LORE]. If you pass, you uncover the story of a past civilization that defeated a cosmic entity; improve [WILL]. If you fail, you can only decipher that there was a great and terrible loss; lose 1 Sanity.

You are hired to rescue people that are trapped in a part of the city that was ruined by tremors. Improve [INFLUENCE]. Digging amid the rubble takes a toll on your body [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you find a survivor; gain 1 CHARACTER Unique Asset. If you fail, the work is too much for you; lose 2 Health.

A priest at St. Swithin's claims the London Stone has revealed your fate. Gain 1 TASK Unique Asset. You listen to voices coming from the stone [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, they reveal dark secrets; spawn 1 Clue. If you fail, the whispers terrify you; lose 1 Sanity.

As you examine the Porta Alchemica, a strange being reaches out to you through the portal. Gain 1 BOON Condition. You speak with the being through the portal [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, it praises your integrity; improve [WILL]. If you fail, your mind corrodes; gain 2 MADNESS Conditions.

Thieves rob a stranger at Sirkeci Terminal, but you vow to track them down. Gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. You follow the thieves to their hideout [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you recover a small fortune; improve [INFLUENCE]. If you fail, they fight you off; lose 1 Health.

The leads you have been hoping to question are in danger of becoming trapped in the underground railway for the duration of a vicious blizzard. You wish to question them, but worry that you will become stranded in the snowstorm as well. You may become Delayed to gain 2 Clues.

You attempt to purchase one of the objects at the Museum of the Souls of Purgatory [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, voices of the dead guide you; improve [WILL] and 1 other skill of your choice. If you fail, you feel the hand of a lost soul grip your heart; lose 1 Sanity.

You endure murky depths of Lake Küçükçekmece in search of gold [WILL - 1]. If you pass, experts from a variety of fields are eager to discuss the treasures you have found; improve [INFLUENCE] and 1 other skill of your choice. If you fail, the dark waters fill you with despair; lose 2 Sanity.

The Thames is flooding and Westminster Hall needs help saving documents from the floodwaters [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you swim out to save several important documents before they float away; spawn 2 Clues. If you fail, the powerful currents carry you downstream; lose 1 Health.

A volcano vent opens in the middle of the street! You jump across a stream of lava to rescue a crying child [STRENGTH]. If you pass, the child's grateful parents are instructors who share their knowledge; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, you get hurt badly; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You study Helena Blavatsky to learn which places she visited while in Istanbul [LORE]. If you pass, you find the same esoteric masters she learned from; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, spirits of the departed haunt your travels; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You study with a monk at the Jing'an Temple. Improve [LORE]. You argue with him about the necessity of your fight against evil [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he helps you; gain 1 random TOME Asset from the deck. If you fail, you fear your work is futile; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You seek proof that a beast on Izu Ōshima causes tremors [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, scientists everywhere offer you help; gain 1 random SERVICE Asset from the deck and 1 Monster of your choice on any space loses 2 Health. If you fail, you search for days without rest; lose 2 Health.

Spearfishers teach you proper diving technique. Improve [STRENGTH]. You explore some of the harbor's many shipwrecks [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a useful object; gain 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, you push yourself too hard; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

The Shanghai Library is flooding, and the books are floating away. Gain 1 random TOME Asset from the deck. You try to save as many as you can [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you rescue many of the waterlogged texts; improve [LORE]. If you fail, your body strains from the effort; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

A Shizoku with typhoid offers you a deal. Gain 1 random SERVICE Asset from the deck. You help care for him as he recovers, but risk being infected yourself [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, he aids your cause; 1 Monster of your choice on any space loses 2 Health. If you fail, you get sick; lose 1 Health.

You dream of Birrahgnooloo, wife of the Sky Father, Baiame. You speak to her of the floods she has brought. If you can prove that you understand her reasons for destruction, she will reward you. You may spend 1 Clue to gain 1 WEAPON Artifact and improve [STRENGTH].

The Royal Asiatic Society caught you taking a book. You try to explain [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, the society members let you go with a warning; gain 1 TOME Artifact. If you fail, you are turned over to the police and must pay damages to the Society; gain a Debt Condition and a Detained Condition.

A beggar asks for coins as a sacrifice to Namazu [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he says the god is pleased with your offering; gain 1 random SERVICE Asset from the deck and 1 Monster of your choice on any space loses 3 Health. If you fail, you live in fear of the god's wrath; lose 2 Sanity.

A heatwave forces you to become leaner. Improve [STRENGTH]. You can buy a device to cool the air in your room [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, people flock to you and share their stories; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, the oppressive heat drives you mad; lose 2 Sanity.

You bravely visit plague victims in the Shanghai General Hospital [WILL - 1]. If you pass, they share their life stories; improve [LORE] and 1 other skill of your choice. If you fail, you cannot stop washing your hands; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

A museum curator asks you to be his guest. Gain 1 random SERVICE Asset from the deck. You buy a print of The Great Wave [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he reveals its true power; discard 1 Monster of your choice on any space. If you fail, it costs you; gain a Debt Condition.

Surrounded by an inferno, you attempt to fight the bushfire [WILL - 1]. If you pass, a grateful city feeds and cares for you; improve [STRENGTH] and 1 other skill of your choice. If you fail, you still see flames everywhere; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You get caught in a gunfight between the police and thieves [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you emerge safely once the smoke clears and find some loot that was left behind; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, the police mistake you for one of the thieves; gain a Detained Condition.

You search the ruins of a small village to discern what happened [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a journal that describes the disasters that befell the town; gain 1 Clue and spawn 1 Clue. If you fail, the tragedy of whatever happened to the ill-fated town fills you with dread; lose 1 Sanity.

The captain has vanished, and you try to decode his encrypted journal [LORE]. If you pass, you uncover his lifelong pursuit; gain 1 TASK Unique Asset. If you fail, your frustrated efforts take a toll on your mind; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You spot your face on a wanted poster. You speak with a federal agent to proclaim your innocence [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, the agent becomes a valuable friend; gain the Agent Callahan Unique Asset. If you fail, the agent arrests you on the spot; gain a Detained Condition.

A man fasting in the wild is confused by his visions. You try to help him understand what he sees [LORE]. If you pass, his visions describe a quest that he was meant to pass on to you; gain 1 TASK Unique Asset. If you fail, his words horrify you; lose 1 Sanity.

During a storm, you hear a voice coming from a blue glow atop the mast. You brave the weather to stay on deck to listen [WILL]. If you pass, the voice teaches you to unlock your potential; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, seasickness drive you below deck; lose 1 Health.

A man has borrowed money to pursue his obsessive quest. You ask him to share the details with you [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he trusts you to help; gain 1 TASK Unique Asset. If you fail, he convinces you to cover what he owes; gain a Debt Condition.

An old hermit asks you to help out with some chores. It proves to be backbreaking work [STRENGTH]. If you pass, the old man teaches you important lessons in return; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, the work proves too demanding; lose 1 Health.
