Supplies are scarce due to rats in the hold. You forgo food so a fellow passenger can eat [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you earn a lifelong friend; gain 1 CHARACTER Unique Asset. If you fail, you give in to hunger as the other person starves; lose 2 Sanity.

You do what you can to alleviate the city's widespread poverty [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, the citizens gratefully offer to share their knowledge; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, the suffering tears at your heart; lose 1 Sanity.

An unwary traveler was buried under a rockslide. You try to move the stones [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you find that though he did not survive, his possessions did; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you cause another rockslide; lose 2 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You signal to a naval craft and demand to speak to the captain [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he believes your story; gain l Agency Secrets Unique Asset. If you fail, he thinks you are dangerous; move to the nearest City space and gain a Detained Condition.

You encounter an elderly version of yourself who claims to have spent years studying in the library. Your other self shows you several obscure books and tries to teach you a lifetime of occult knowledge [LORE - 1].

You grasp the important lessons. Close this Gate. However, your other self indicates that there is still a great deal for you to learn, if you are willing to stay and continue your studies. You may become Delayed to gain 2 Clues.

Speaking to your future self is too bizarre to endure. Gain 1 MADNESS Condition. You try to do as the other you instructs [WILL]. If you pass, you succeed; close this Gate. If you fail, you make an error that results in the death of the other you; lose 2 Sanity.

You find yourself trapped in a strange alien body, surrounded by the broken bodies of other yithians. You hear a loud wind howling overhead. A blind panic creeps into your thoughts and you struggle to retain your reason [WILL].

You see a strange device that can heal the tear in reality. Close this Gate. The machine is inscribed with symbols [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you learn where an important object is kept; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the strange icons mean nothing to you; lose 3 Sanity.
You run blindly through the dark and are nearly crushed by the might of a flying polyp [STRENGTH]. If you fail, the massive creature throws you sharply against the rocks; lose 6 Health.

You learn that many cults throughout time and space worship the yithians. Resolve the pass effect to learn about these organizations from the city's library; or resolve the fail effect to ask the creatures directly about these cults.

You learn what you can from the city's extensive records [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you learn how to contact the cults and get their help; close this Gate. If you fail, you suspect everyone has always been in the thrall of the Great Race; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

The Great Race seem very protective of the cults and question you aggressively about your intentions [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you are allowed to request the cult's help; close this Gate. If you fail, their questions anger and confuse you; lose 2 Sanity.

You appear on the continent of Mu the day it was destroyed and pulled beneath the ocean. Resolve the pass effect to discover what you can before the island is destroyed; or resolve the fail effect to reverse the magic that pulled you here.

The carnage around you is traumatic to witness [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you find ancient sorcerers trying to save Mu who are willing to use their power to repair the tear in reality; close this Gate. If you fail, the horror is too much to bear; lose 2 Sanity.

You try to manipulate the residual energy of the magic [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you harness the power to repair the damage to time and space; close this Gate. If you fail, your error makes you partly responsible for the destruction of Mu; gain 1 BANE Condition.

A hooded figure invites you to sit. His pen is poised to write, and he looks to you expectantly, waiting for you to tell him a story. You may spend 1 Clue to resolve the pass effect. If you do not spend the Clue, resolve the fail effect.

The figure nods and writes the next chapter of your story, restoring reality to its original state. Close this Gate. You are afraid to read any further [WILL]. If you pass, you see how your character develops; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you see how you die; lose 1 Sanity.

The figure invents a story about your failure. Lose 2 Sanity. At the conclusion of the tale, he inscribes a phrase in an alien language [LORE]. If you pass, you interpret the words and speak them aloud to mend the tear in reality; close this Gate.

You find yourself in an abandoned mine on Thog, one of the moons of Yuggoth. Somewhere in the distance you can hear the distinctive cries of shoggoths. The sound terrifies you to your core and you fight the urge to flee [WILL - 1].

You find abandoned equipment that can be used to return you home. Close this Gate. Before you go, you search the area [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a series of revelatory murals; gain 2 Clues. If you fail, you stumble in the dark; discard 2 ITEM possessions.

You run blindly and find yourself surrounded by strange fungi [LORE]. If you pass, you use the mushrooms to repair reality; close this Gate. If you fail, you suffer a terrible delusional trauma as a result of the mushrooms; lose 3 Sanity.
An ancient threat has taken root in Fleet River, a subterranean waterway that has been bricked up for nearly two hundred years. You try to convince the city officials to open the chamber [INFLUENCE].

You trade a favor for access to the sealed area. Gain 1 TASK Unique Asset. You search the murky river [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a vile statue and destroy it; advance the active Mystery by 1. If you fail, the foul water sickens you; lose 2 Health.

Breaking in at night, you find the water teeming with serpents. Gain 1 MADNESS Condition. You try to summon the courage to remove the snakes [WILL]. If you pass, you clear the area; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you scream and run; lose 2 Sanity.

You learn that a powerful occult object is being held in the Black Museum at Scotland Yard. Resolve the pass effect to convince the police to give you access; or resolve the fail effect to break in at night.

You attempt to convince the police of your credentials [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you are given free access to the museum's notorious exhibits; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you are arrested on the spot; gain a Detained Condition.

Your incursion goes smoothly until you reach a locked door inside the museum. You try to break the lock using force [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you are free to search the items on display; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, your effort leaves you bruised; lose 2 Health.

Due to city ordinance, the Odd Fellows Cemetery is obliged to move its bodies to a new location. You try to warn the authorities about cults that would take advantage of the situation to steal corpses [INFLUENCE].

You receive training to watch for occult activity. Improve [OBSERVATION]. When the cult arrives to steal the cadavers, you attack their leader [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you catch him; advance the active Mystery by 1. If you fail, you are badly hurt; lose 2 Health.

You spend the night alone in the Cemetery. Lose 1 Sanity. The cult arrives, and you follow them [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you tell the police of their lair; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you are blamed for the theft; gain a Detained Condition.

An important treasure was buried beneath the ground in the hull of a decommissioned ship. Resolve the pass effect to hire a guide to find the lost ship; or resolve the fail effect to dig up old vessels until you find it.

You hire a local historian [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he takes you through a passage to the ship you seek; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, he abandons you in a vast maze of pitch black tunnels; gain 1 INJURY Condition and 1 MADNESS Condition.

Using your own loose knowledge of the ship's final location, you spend day and night digging [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you uncover the craft; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the effort is too much for your body to withstand; lose 2 Health.
Visiting the Longhua Temple, you are horrified to encounter the spirits of thousands of victims who have been imprisoned and executed on this site. They cry out to you in a ghastly cacophony [WILL].

You listen to their stories and learn of their deaths. Improve [LORE]. They beg you to find their bodies [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the grateful spirits aid you in your cause; advance the active Mystery by 1. If you fail, they inflict their wounds upon you; lose 2 Health.

You collapse in a panic. Lose 1 Sanity. You beg the spirits to have mercy [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, the ghosts see the good within you and relent; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, they terrorize you until you snap; gain 2 MADNESS Conditions.

A wealthy antiquities dealer's safe was dropped into a deep river. Resolve the pass effect to open the safe under the water's surface; or resolve the fail effect to try to get the safe back on dry land.

You do your best to crack the combination lock while submerged [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, the door springs open revealing an important treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you lose something while fumbling about in the water; discard 1 ITEM possession.

The safe is extremely heavy and difficult to recover [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you push it up on to a sidewalk and open it easily; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, you nearly drown yourself struggling against its tremendous weight; lose 2 Health.

No one else seems to notice the shaman that stands in the street before you, adorned with gold and bone, hand outstretched in silence. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you do not gain the Condition, a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

You search the debris left behind in the wake of some gargantuan creature [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you spot something protruding from the rubble; gain this Clue and 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, you are nearly buried as some of the debris collapses upon you; lose 2 Health.

You spot shifting earth on a distant shoreline, as if something is burrowing beneath the ground. Gain this Clue. Enraptured by the spectacle, you are barely aware of your surroundings [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, you stumble into the railing and some of your things fall overboard; discard 1 ITEM possession.

You partake in a proposed experiment that infuses the bearer with a serum extracted from the corpse of a cthonian [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you survive the process; gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, the serum wreaks havoc on your body; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You explore a tunnel left behind by some sort of giant worm. Gain this Clue. You hear a rumbling in the tunnels ahead of you and try to hide [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a place to hide; gain 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you lead the creature toward civilization as you flee; advance Doom by 1.

Hail the size of your fist begins to strike the deck of your ship, and you look for a place to hide [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you hide below deck and lift some of the cargo during the chaos; gain this Clue and 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, you are severely pummeled; lose 2 Health.

A man covered in piercings and tattoos attacks you while you quietly eat a warm meal in a local diner. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [STRENGTH] test, he drops his weapon and flees into the night; gain this Clue and 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck.

You discover a swath of scorched earth and try to determine the cause [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you discover the fragment of a meteor that pulses when you touch it; gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, something in the air warps your mind; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

A hooded man tells you of a great worm worshiped in times long past. Gain this Clue. You notice his skin is covered in markings [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you realize that he is a disciple of Shudde M'ell; gain 1 additional Clue. If you fail, simply looking upon the marks corrupts you; gain 1 BANE Condition.

You witness hooded men meeting in an alley. Gain this Clue. You keep your distance, but follow them back to their hideout [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you continue to eavesdrop undetected; gain 1 additional Clue. If you fail, they catch on, and collapse their own hideout with you inside; lose 3 Health.

Someone is darting to and fro between the trees. You attempt to follow him [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you startle the man and he drops what he is carrying; gain this Clue and 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you do not notice a gaping hole in the ground before you and fall in; lose 2 Health.

A shaman living on an uncharted archipelago is the source of a recent slew of earthquakes. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [STRENGTH] test, you subdue the shaman; gain this Clue. If you fail the [STRENGTH] test, the shaman opens up the earth, swallowing one of your companions; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You evaluate how best to free someone trapped in a collapsed building by a sudden earthquake [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you carefully remove debris until the person is freed; gain this Clue and 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, the debris collapses further, injuring you both; lose 2 Health.

The glyphs on an ancient warding-stone suggest you might use it to experience the memories of a shaman long dead. However, simply touching the stone makes you itch, a vile corruption festering beneath your skin. You may gain 1 BANE Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

Your ship navigates through a sea of flotsam from what appears to have been a great flood [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you spot something useful in the debris; gain this Clue and 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you find only the bodies of those washed out to sea; lose 1 Sanity.

A high strung police officer demands that you hand over your weapons [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he calms down and you learn that recent cult activity has the police on edge; gain this Clue. If you fail, nothing you say will dissuade him from confiscating your things; discard 1 WEAPON possession.

The ground begins to tremble and shake, and a piercing shriek echoes across the landscape. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [WILL] test, you carefully observe the creature's movements even as you are fighting it; gain this Clue.

A tiny island in the ocean harbors a fully intact warding-stone. Breaking it apart may allow you to learn more about how the mysterious stones work, but whatever horror the ward is hiding will be freed upon the world. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

A recent tremor has unearthed a maze of pitch-black tunnels beneath the city [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you feel your way through the tunnels and find a shrine to the serpent god Apophis; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you cause a cave-in; lose 2 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You feel the ground begin to shake and try to hold absolutely still [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you freeze in place as a colossal worm burrows up from the ground; gain this Clue. If you fail, your movement attracts a terrifying subterranean creature; an Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you!

During your journey, you attempt a ritual that purports to grant prescience to the followers of Apophis [LORE]. If you pass, the ritual works; gain this Clue and improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, you are deemed unworthy; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

A girl has been trapped by a fallen beam, but you do not know if you have the power to save her [WILL]. If you pass, adrenaline courses through you and you lift the beam; gain this Clue and improve [STRENGTH]. If you fail, you hurt yourself in your attempt to free her; lose 2 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You follow the trail of uprooted trees left behind by some great, burrowing creature [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you come across the creature's nest, and observe its comings and goings; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you become hopelessly lost; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You do not remember seeing the man in black when your ship left port, but his offer seems genuine. He offers you knowledge of how to use water against the cthonians for an undisclosed favor at a future date. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1.

Tremors threaten to shake the building apart, and you summon all of your might to keep the door frame from collapsing [STRENGTH]. If you pass, all of the building's occupants escape into the street; gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, the building collapses into a heap; lose 3 Health.

You examine the pieces of a shattered warding-stone and attempt to piece them back together [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the stone hums to life; gain this Clue and improve [STRENGTH]. If you fail, the stone explodes once more, sending rocks flying in every direction; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You keep a lookout for anything in the water that might slow the ship [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you divert the ship around the drowned corpse of a massive worm; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, the dark waters call to you; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

Wood and stone sail through the air as a giant worm bursts up from beneath the street. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [WILL] test, you retain enough of your mental faculties through the chaos to notice that the beast has no eyes; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You find a nest of eggs left behind by the giant worms. The shells are hard as iron, but you try to crush the eggs before the worms return [STRENGTH]. If you pass, the earth shakes with each egg you crush; gain this Clue. If you fail, the worms return to chase you away; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

The corpse of a giant worm has washed up on an island. You dig through its entrails in search of anything it might have swallowed [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a piece of a warding-stone; gain this Clue and improve [WILL]. If you fail, prolonged exposure to its alien physiology makes you ill; lose 3 Health.

You ask a librarian for Sir Amery Wendy-Smith's book On Ancient Civilizations [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, she finds it for you and it reveals much; gain this Clue and improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, she brings you his terrifying account of G'harne instead; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You peer down the slope of a deep crater and see something shining on a ledge below. You try to climb down to reach it [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you find a destroyed warding-stone; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you tumble down the steep incline; gain 3 INJURY Conditions.

A high-pitched whining noise is getting louder and louder [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you see something streaking through the air toward you and dive aside; gain this Clue. If you fail, something crashes into the deck and you are peppered with razor-sharp splinters of wood; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You read a portion of Wendy-Smith's translation of the G'harne Manuscript. Gain this Clue. Desperate for more, you bid on a translation of the remaining fragments [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, you acquire the texts; improve [LORE]. If you fail, your mental state degrades; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You watch in horror as a fellow traveler is swallowed up by the earth. You dig frantically with your hands to save him [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you uncover him, as well as a network of tunnels; gain this Clue. If you fail, your hands are bloody and raw from the digging; lose 2 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

The seas churn and islands tremble as a volley of meteorites falls all around. You watch where they land [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you note where they fall; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you are too distracted to notice the crates of cargo sliding toward you; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You speak with the increasingly erratic archaeologist Amery Wendy-Smith to learn what he knows about G'harne [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he offers to join you; gain the Amery Wendy-Smith Unique Asset. If you fail, he begins to laugh manically rocking back and forth in place; lose 1 Sanity.

The land is blackened and dead where a fire recently passed. You survey the charred landscape [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you deduce that the fire was caused by an unnaturally destructive thunderstorm; gain this Clue. If you fail, the bleak desolation unsettles your nerves; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You spot a man floating in the water, and dive in to rescue him [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you drag the man aboard the ship, and he tells you that his village was destroyed by a great worm; gain this Clue. If you fail, you nearly drown trying to reach him; lose 2 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

A furious-looking man names you a traitor to mankind and challenges you to a duel [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, once you have subdued him, he explains that he mistook you for a follower of Apophis; gain this Clue. If you fail, you are wounded during the fight; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You find yourself suddenly paralyzed, unable to move. The cold wind of chaos breathes heavily on the back of your neck, and a barely audible whisper offers you the power to stem the flood of darkness. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Vach-Viraj Chant Artifact.

You spend several hours observing an impressive meteor shower [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you realize that the meteor fragments are not burning up as they enter the atmosphere; gain this Clue. If you fail, you become entranced by the fiery display; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You are attacked in an alleyway by a would-be assassin, and try to overpower him [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you learn that he was hired by a man with many tribal piercings; gain this Clue and 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, you are gravely injured during the struggle; lose 3 Health.

You come upon a giant egg just as it is hatching, and attempt to subdue the worm-like larvae as it emerges from the shell [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you study it for a time before it gathers enough strength to escape; gain this Clue. If you fail, it nearly crushes you; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

An elderly monk, sitting cross-legged on a rock in the middle of the ocean, riddles you to test your worth [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, the priest gifts you with a vial of consecrated seawater; gain the Tikkoun Elixir Artifact. If you fail, he cackles maniacally and disappears; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You hear whispers calling you down aisle after aisle of forgotten books. You try to glean meaning from the strange language [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the whispers lead you to a book in a glass case; gain 1 TOME Artifact. If you fail, you wander the aisles for days; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

The ground shakes and trees begin to splinter in the distance, and you see a wall of water rushing toward you. You scramble to scale a rocky cliff face [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you make it to safety and watch the tsunami pass; gain this Clue. If you fail, the water slams you into a rock face; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You navigate using some old sea charts, improvising based on current conditions [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you deftly navigate the reefs that have appeared in recent months; gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, the ship runs aground, throwing you sharply into a wall; gain 3 INJURY Conditions.

An alchemist claims to have reproduced the effects of holy water using his own original concoction. He suggests it might afford you protection against the worm-like cthonians and begs you to be his first test subject. You may spend 3 Health to gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition.

You see a series of markings etched onto trees and stones and into the earth. You attempt to make sense of them [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, they lead you to a cave that contains a powerful relic; gain 1 WEAPON Artifact. If you fail, you believe the signs foretell the end-times; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

As you lead a team to a volcano at the center of a small islet, a tremor knocks one of your companions off-balance [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you steady your companion; gain this Clue and 1 random ALLY Asset Prom the deck. If you fail, you watch as your companion falls into the caldera; lose 1 Sanity.

You pore over a stack of dusty papers in search of the location of the lost city of G'harne [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you piece together excerpts from several texts to find what you seek, gain this Clue. If you fail, you come to believe the city is both everywhere and nowhere; gain l MADNESS Condition.

You come across a nest of giant eggs. Gain this Clue. As you near the eggs, you feel yourself lose control of your body [WILL]. If you pass, you break free of the control; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you wake up days later with no memory of anything that occurred; gain 1 BANE Condition.

Atop a hill on a deserted island, a strange object protrudes from the ground. You try to pull it out, storm clouds gathering as you struggle [STRENGTH]. If you pass, it comes free with a mighty crash; gain the Lightning Gun Artifact. If you fail, you are struck by lightning and severely burned; lose 3 Health.

You hear a weak cry for help as you pass a collapsed building, and try to find the victim [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find someone trapped beneath a fallen pillar; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, the cries for help eventually stop; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You sift through the rubble of an utterly destroyed shack far from civilization [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find the remains of a ritual circle; gain this Clue and 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you trip over a loose floorboard and fall into a puddle of pungent ooze; lose 1 Sanity.

You try to pry open a crate marked with the word "G'harne" [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you find the box to be full of shattered fragments of stone; gain this Clue. If you fail, the crate slides around while you struggle to open it, crushing you against a wall; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You walk through a district of the city that has been remarkably unaffected by the quakes [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, everywhere you go you see a peculiar sign etched into the buildings; gain this Clue. If you fail, a strange buzzing noise tugs at the fringes of your awareness; lose 1 Sanity.

You spend time in the wild in order to become closer to nature, but the nights spent alone are terrifying [WILL - 1]. If you pass, your time in the wild has made you stronger; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, you are badly hurt one night while fleeing from a bear; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You compare two waterlogged maps that were found on islands long thought lost to rising sea levels [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find evidence connecting Stonehenge with G'harne; gain this Clue. If you fail, nothing seems to make sense anymore; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

With a thundering crash, a massive worm comes barreling through a building, splinters flying inches from your head. Your instinct urges you to flee, but opportunities to study these creatures are scarce. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you! You may gain 1 INJURY Condition to gain this Clue.

You follow a series of glowing stones that lead you to a tiny camp where some shady-looking men are talking. Gain this Clue. You attempt to raid their camp [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you get away unseen; gain 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, they leave with their weapons; advance Doom by 1.

Fear grips you as you feel an outside force assault your mind [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you fight it off and peer inside its mind as you do; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, you slide around, slamming into walls and railings as you fight to retain control; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You sift through the debris of destroyed buildings to find anything useful that is yet unbroken [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find something; gain 1 random WEAPON Asset from the deck. If you fail, you find a revolver that ends up blowing up in your hands the first time you fire it; lose 1 Health.

You attempt to piece together the broken shards of a warding-stone, such that the symbols inscribed upon them form a cohesive sequence [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the symbols form an arcane chant; gain this Clue and 1 INCANTATION Spell. If you fail, the symbols are burned into your mind; lose 1 Sanity.

A lunatic hermit on a small islet in the middle of the ocean allegedly knows the true weakness of the cthonians, but he demands that you trade him something in return for the undoubtedly valuable information. You may discard 1 ITEM possession to gain this Clue.

You break into the police station to read a classified report about a recent series of ritualistic killings in areas affected by the recent earthquakes. Gain this Clue. You try to escape without being seen [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, you are caught in the act and your things are confiscated; discard 1 WEAPON possession.

The earth falls away beneath your feet, and you find yourself falling toward the gaping maw of a horrifying worm creature. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you! If you pass the [STRENGTH] test, the severely wounded creature returns to its subterranean lair; retreat Doom by 1.

An old witch of the sea teaches you a trick to use against the cthonians [LORE]. If you pass, you easily master the complex rite; gain this Clue and 1 GLAMOUR Spell. If you fail, the miscast magic rends the flesh from your bones; lose 2 Health.

The buildings around you rattle and shake. You attune your mind with the source of the tremors [LORE]. If you pass, you glimpse the mind of a cthonian; gain this Clue and 1 RITUAL Spell. If you fail, you have made yourself an easy target; an Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you!

You see a young man gripping the ledge of a freshly dug pit and try to throw him a rope [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, he offers payment for saving him; gain this Clue and improve [INFLUENCE]. If you fail, you drop the rope, and one of your friends falls into the pit while trying to recover it; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You train tirelessly during your lengthy voyage, knowing that the devastated cities of the world will offer you no succor [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you unlock potential you never knew you possessed; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, the strain on your body is too great; lose 2 Health.

You descend a rocky path into a massive rift that spans half the city. Crumbling stones litter the ravine below, remnants of buildings that were once level with the city above. You enter a large tunnel at the base of the ravine in search of whatever caused the city's destruction [OBSERVATION - 1].

You come across what appears to be a nest of gargantuan eggs. As you approach, you find yourself fighting for control of your body [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you flee the cavern with your mind intact; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, you awake hours later in the jungle with no memory; lose 1 Sanity.
Your search is cut short, as your reckless stumbling about has drawn unwanted attention to your presence. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you!

Unfamiliar with the area and having only the vaguest of notes left by a previous expedition, you barter with the shaman of a tribe that lives on the outskirts of G'harne to lead you deeper into the lost city [INFLUENCE - 1].

At the city's center you search for any hint of what might have happened to the beings that once dwelt there [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a massive warding-stone sundered in two; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, you stumble into a pit trap while examining some intricate murals; gain 1 INJURY Condition.
The shaman readily agrees to be your guide. He leads you deep into the domain of the dark masters he serves. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you!

You walk about the ruined city, noting the many instances of one oddly familiar symbol carved into stones and etched upon walls as you go. You take care not to disturb anything the symbol touches [OBSERVATION - 1].

You try to remember where you have seen the symbol before [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you recognize it as the Elder Sign; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, the strange symbol becomes etched into your memory and is all that you can think about; gain a Hallucinations Condition.
In your haste, you mistakenly step on a stone marked by the unusual symbol. With a crack and a flash, it shatters, and its latent arcane energy seeps into your bones. Gain 1 BANE Condition.

You find yourself surrounded by men and women in black and brown robes. Several of them begin moving toward you while the rest begin chanting in unison. You try to keep your attackers at bay [STRENGTH - 1].

You realize that the cultists are summoning some creature and look for a way to stop the ritual [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you notice one is dressed differently from the rest and tackle her, ending the chant and scattering the cult into the jungle; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, resolve the fail effect.
Your assailants subdue you. Suddenly, the chanting ends, and the ground begins to tremble beneath your feet. An Ancient Cthonian Epic Monster ambushes you!

A vast subterranean chamber, deep within a heavily fortified area of the ruins, splits into two paths, both descending into darkness. Someone has written a riddle on the walls in blood. You think it is telling you which direction to go [OBSERVATION - 1].

You traverse what you believe to be the correct path. Suddenly, a bloodied man in tattered clothed leaps from the shadows [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you subdue him and realize that he is a survivor of the previous expedition; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, he bites you and flees; lose 2 Health.
You follow a path deeper into the earth for some time. By the time you realize your error, you are lost in the deep tunnels of G'harne. Lose 3 Sanity and become Delayed.

You find the entrance to a large underground cavern on the outskirts of the ruins, but it is covered by a rock twice your size. You throw your weight against the rock, hoping that it will budge enough to grant you entry [STRENGTH - 1].

Inside, you come face-to-face with an elder thing! You frantically attempt to communicate with it [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, it shows you visions of G'harne in the distant past; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, it sends you reeling violently through time and space back into the jungle; lose 1 Health.
You strain yourself for hours to make only the slightest progress. You attempt to squeeze through the narrow gap, but the boulder shifts, trapping you until someone hears your screams. Lose 3 Health.

As you explore the ruined city, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. Whirling about, you find yourself staring into the shadowy face of a hooded figure, unable to distinguish any features, yet unable to look away [WILL - 1].

You feel a force acting on your mind. You lash out at the hooded figure [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you throw yourself at the figure and fa11 to the ground but when you recover, the figure is gone; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, you lose yourself to the alien force; resolve the fail effect.
You awake some time later, lying among the remains of shattered warding-stones. Your memory of the past hours floods back to you. You are responsible for this destruction. Advance Doom by 1.

You find a colossal warding-stone, larger than all of the others, pierced by a massive thorn at the heart of the city. You summon all your power and try to pull the thorn from the stone [STRENGTH - 1].

As the thorn comes free, you catch a glimpse of a fiery alien hellscape through the hole in the stone. Flames lick at the aperture in anticipation. You attempt to seal the portal [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the passage is closed; place 1 Eldritch token on the active Mystery. If you fail, the earth begins to tremble; resolve the fail effect.
Unable to sustain the stress of your clumsy meddling, the ward explodes, throwing you backward and lacerating your body with razor-sharp shrapnel. Gain 3 INJURY Conditions.
The sky turns a pale green and the air grows deathly still. Every bird and scurrying creature races to find shelter from the oncoming storm.
The Lead Investigator and other investigators within 2 spaces each lose 2 Sanity, move to a random space, and become Delayed.
The ground itself rises and plunges ferociously. Bridges twist and contort, heaving those passing over them into the bay.
Each investigator on San Francisco or an adjacent space loses 3 Health and 3 Sanity and becomes Delayed.
San Francisco is devastated!
One by one, the city's landmarks inexplicably explode in an act of meticulously orchestrated anarchy. The subsequent riots and looting cannot be contained.
Each investigator on London loses 5 Health and 3 Sanity and gains 2 MADNESS Conditions.
London is devastated!
The passengers' complaints about delays give way to silent despair. It is clear now that the track will not be cleared before the night's killing frost descends.
Each investigator on a space connected to a Train path loses 2 Health and becomes Delayed.
Then return all Train tickets to the game box.
Outside, you can hear the roar of powerful winds embedding countless shards of lethal debris into the walls. The roof groans, threatening to disappear into the sky.
Each investigator on Buenos Aires or an adjacent space loses 3 Sanity, gains 2 INJURY Conditions, and becomes Delayed.
Buenos Aires is devastated!
The fire above you illuminates the entire night sky. For a moment, the display is beautiful. Then the large stones crater the landscape like the wrath of a god.
Determine a random space. Each investigator on that space or an adjacent space loses 2 Health and 2 Sanity.
Repeat this process four additional times.
The rain of fiery stones shatters the city's marble columns and collapses its domes. The meteorites' thunderous barrage soon reduces the city to rubble.
Each investigator on Istanbul loses 5 Health and 3 Sanity and gains 2 INJURY Conditions.
Istanbul is devastated!
An electric shock courses through you. Nearby, glass windows and various ceramics shatter into pieces and begin to rise. The air itself is punctured by an invading void.
Spawn a number of Gates as indicated by the Reference card. Then spawn one Monster on each space containing a Gate.
The flurries of snow and a thick layer of ice make the roads impassable. The radio announcer grimly says that it will be weeks before a rescue is possible.

Each investigator on any of the following spaces - 1, 4, 5, 9, 13, 14, 16, 19, Arkham, Istanbul, London, Rome, San Francisco, Tokyo, Tunguska, or The Himalayas — loses 2 Health and 2 Sanity and becomes Delayed.
Panicked survivors clamber to the rooftops clutching what few heirlooms they could rescue. Below, the rapidly rising waters swallow the streets.
Each investigator on Shanghai loses 5 Sanity, gains 2 INJURY Conditions, and becomes Delayed.
Shanghai is devastated!
Everywhere you run, fire and smoke seems to be ahead of you. Once the flames reach the oil refinery at Botany Bay, the end becomes inevitable.
Each investigator on Sydney loses 4 Health and 4 Sanity and gains 2 MADNESS Conditions.
Sydney is devastated!
The streets are littered with mangled bodies, torn apart by something enormous and cruel. You look up and see two moons glowering above the gambrel roofs.
Spawn a number of Monsters on Arkham equal to half the number of investigators + 2. Each investigator adjacent to Arkham moves to Arkham, then each investigator on Arkham becomes Delayed.
Arkham is devastated!
A wall of water escapes Tokyo Bay and inundates everything in its path, picking buildings up off their foundations and tossing cars around like toy boats.
Each investigator on Tokyo loses 3 Health and 5 Sanity and gains 2 INJURY Conditions.
Tokyo is devastated!

cards.title: UNNATURAL OCCURRENCES LEAVE ROME IN SHAMBLES!

sections.header: UNNATURAL OCCURRENCES LEAVE ROME IN SHAMBLES!
sections.text: The air is thick with a sulfurous fog. Judging by the fissures in the ground, you determine the source of the occult devastation must be beneath the Vatican.
Each investigator on Rome loses 5 Sanity unless he gains a Cursed Condition. Each investigator on an adjacent space loses 3 Sanity unless he gains a Cursed Condition.
Rome is devastated!
All around the world, locations of great importance are reduced to rubble overnight.

Each investigator on the Active Expedition space or an adjacent space loses 2 Health and 2 Sanity. Search the Expedition Encounter deck for each card corresponding to the Active Expedition and return it to the game box, then shuffle the Expedition Encounter deck.
Repeat this process two additional times.
Like a living thing, the deluge crosses the water's surface, carried by the deafening winds. It paralyzes you with a primal fear of nature's raw and indiscriminate destructive power.
Each investigator on a Sea space loses 2 Sanity and becomes Delayed.
Then return all Ship tickets to the game box.

A friend of yours says he knows where an important treasure was hidden before the tragedy. Resolve the pass effect to send your friend to retrieve the object; or resolve the fail effect to look for it yourself.

You impress on your friend how important this treasure would be to your cause [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, your friend returns successfully; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, your friend absconds with the treasure and is never seen again; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You search the area [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find that the treasure was destroyed, but its fragments can still be used to ward off evil; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you search the desolate wasteland fruitlessly; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

A cult has established itself in the ruins of the city and is terrorizing those survivors who remain. Resolve the pass effect to convince the survivors to defend themselves; or resolve the fail effect to infiltrate the cult.

You gather the survivors and make an impassioned speech [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, their resistance is a worldwide inspiration; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, they all eventually succumb to the cult; lose 3 Sanity.

The cult will not accept you unless you establish your arcane knowledge [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you sabotage the cultists and steal one of their prized possessions; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, they attack you; lose 2 Health.

You know that survivors are in desperate need of resources, but conspicuous signs of wealth make you a target for thieves. Resolve the pass effect to bring extra food and supplies with you; or resolve the fail effect to bring only basic equipment.

The survivors are overjoyed to see you. You try to enlist their help [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, one survivor in particular comes to your aid; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, you despair when it seems that their fears cannot be overcome; lose 2 Sanity.

You are caught off-guard by the awful conditions of the city and worry that you are woefully unprepared [WILL]. If you pass, you become adept at hiding from the bandits that dwell within the city limits; improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, you begin to grow unhinged; lose 1 Sanity.

Part of the building you are exploring collapses, trapping you inside. Resolve the pass effect to search the basement for a tunnel that connects to another building; or resolve the fail effect to try to dig your way out.

You search the shadowy basement halls [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find both an exit and important documents that were left behind; gain 1 Clue. If you fail, you spend endless hours feeling your way around in the dark; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You do your best to dig through the rubble [STRENGTH]. If you pass, your efforts attract the attention of a survivor who offers to help you; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, working alone is a tremendous strain on your body; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

Rescue efforts have stopped due to wild animal attacks. Resolve the pass effect to try convincing authorities to renew their attempts to reach survivors; or resolve the fail effect to enter the ruined city alone.

You beg for help rescuing survivors [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, a talented stranger agrees to assist you; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, those who lend their help only attract more animal attacks, despite their best intentions; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You try to sneak through the rubble [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the people you have saved thank you with what little they have to offer; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, the beasts catch your scent; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You know that someone is stalking you through the debris, but you aren't sure of the person's intentions. Resolve the pass effect to try to catch the one who has been following you; or resolve the fail effect to call out to the person.

You try to turn the tables on your pursuer [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the person flees, leaving behind a useful object; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you are overwhelmed; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You offer a bribe to your pursuer [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, the stranger steps out of the shadows to join you; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, your voice draws the attention of a truly nightmarish creature; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

Several survivors have fallen under a trance and are walking slowly toward dark fissures in the ground. You deduce that they are being summoned by the telepathic call of a cthonian. Resolve the pass effect to try to stop them; or resolve the fail effect to follow them.

The cthonian's thoughts invade your mind [WILL]. If you pass, the creature's arcane presence only serves to make you more powerful; improve [STRENGTH]. If you fail, you eventually awaken and find that one of your friends is missing; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You track the survivors through the endless tunnels [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find them before they are consumed and they reward you for your efforts; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you stumble through the tunnels in the dark; lose 1 Health.

You try to lead a group of survivors to safety, but additional tremors have turned the road you used to enter the city into an impassable wall of rubble. Resolve the pass effect to coordinate an attempt to clear a path; or the fail effect to stay where you are.

You try to organize the survivors' efforts to clear the rubble [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, you all reach safety and they gratefully reward you; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. It you fail, you end up doing most of the work yourself; lose 1 Health.
As you learn about the survivors, you learn they have much to teach you if you are willing to invest the time and effort to learn. You may become Delayed to gain 1 TALENT Condition.

You and your companions desperately need to find a source of fresh water. Resolve the pass effect to start digging a well; or resolve the fail effect to search for a way to restore the city's water supply.

You need to dig much deeper than you anticipated to reach a fresh source of water [STRENGTH]. If you fail, your efforts take too long and one of your companions succumbs to dehydration; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You scrutinize the city's water distribution system, looking for intact pipes [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, your only hope for survival is to use some of your equipment to patch those places where the pipes have been broken; discard 1 ITEM possession.

Unscrupulous profiteers are stealing from homes that were left unprotected when the city was abandoned. Resolve the pass effect to patrol the ruined city yourself; or resolve the fail effect to convince one of your companions to do so.

You keep a vigilant watch over the city to put an end to the thefts [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, one of the profiteers manages to sneak past you and steals something of yours; discard 1 ITEM possession.

You insist that one of your associates protect these homes from thieves [INFLUENCE]. If you fail, your companion does not agree that such work is important and reacts poorly to being ordered to do it; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

An enormous fire rages throughout what little remains of the city. You run yourself ragged running back and forth, gathering as much sand and water as you can in an effort to extinguish the raging inferno before it consumes all [STRENGTH - 1].

Once the fire has died down you search the charred remains of the city [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a peculiar arcane object that managed to survive; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, the lingering smoke overwhelms you; lose 3 Health.

As the fire grows, you hear people shouting from a burning building. You try to summon the courage to save them [WILL]. If you pass, they offer you a reward; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, their screams haunt you; lose 2 Sanity.

The survivors have vanished, leaving behind strange symbols. Setting up a search party would take weeks. You may become Delayed to resolve the pass effect. If you do not become Delayed, you study the symbols; resolve the fail effect.

You attempt to cover the expenses necessary to organize a search party [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, your effort was worthwhile and you rescue thousands of people; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you achieve nothing but exhausting yourself; lose 2 Health.

You scrutinize the arcane symbols that the survivors left behind [LORE]. If you pass, you grasp the message they gave their lives to convey; gain 1 Clue. If you fail, the mystery haunts your conscience; lose 2 Sanity.

The military has been sent in to protect survivors. After encountering the voracious creatures that prowl through the night, however, the soldiers are anxious to leave. You try to convince them to stay and fight [INFLUENCE].

You lead the soldiers against the vicious beasts that prowl the city [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you rescue a survivor who gratefully joins you; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, you lose something important as you retreat; discard 1 ITEM possession.

You promise not to abandon the survivors after the soldiers leave. Each night you hear the terrifying sounds of the beasts [WILL]. If you pass, you use your time to hone your abilities; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you flee from your duty; lose 1 Sanity.

Disease runs rampant through those still trapped within the city's ruins. Soon you begin suffering from the same fever and skin lesions as others who have already lost their life to the affliction. You struggle to fight off the disease [STRENGTH].

You search for a qualified doctor to use your blood to create a cure [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, those who recover offer you a reward; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, the inexperienced doctor draws too much of your blood; lose 2 Health.

You offer a reward to anyone who will care for you [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, a stranger is sympathetic to your plight; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, no one helps you and you slip into a debilitating delirium; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

Hiding in the ruins of a store, you hear the sniffing and growling of some enormous creature just outside. As the sounds grow louder, you are certain it has caught your scent. The beast howls, signaling to others, and you struggle to resist blind panic [WILL].

You remain calm and well-hidden but some of your companions insist that running away is the only way to survive. You try to convince them to stay hidden [INFLUENCE]. If you fail, one of them makes a break for it and is immediately pounced upon; discard 1 ALLY Asset.

You run as fast as you can through the night, stumbling over the uneven terrain as you make your escape [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, you trip and your possessions go skittering across the ground; discard 1 ITEM possession.

Some entropic power seems to pervade the remains of this city, causing everything to fall apart or break down. You have to keep a careful watch on your equipment to keep all of it in working order [OBSERVATION].

You ask mad Lord Northam about his travels [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he calms down and tells you of his strange journeys; gain 1 TASK Unique Asset and spawn 1 Clue. If you fail, he recites a chant he found in the Nameless City; gain a Corruption Condition.

The Tokkō takes action! A Monster of your choice on any space loses 2 Health. The thought police then question you [WILL - 1]. If you pass, they offer you help; gain 1 random SERVICE Asset from the deck. If you fail, your mind breaks; gain an Amnesia Condition.

A hospitalized veteran dubbed "George Brown" with no memory has been speaking an ancient language [LORE]. If you pass, you learn the secrets of warfare left in his mind by Yithians; improve [STRENGTH]. If you fail, he attacks you; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

Wenchang Wang's priest brings you a gift. Gain 1 random TOME Asset from the deck. He asks you to speak of your troubles [WILL - 1]. If you pass, he reveals what these trials have taught you; improve [LORE]. If you fail, you cannot endure the memories; lose 1 Sanity.

Edogawa Ranpo identifies the culprit! Discard 1 Monster of your choice with toughness 2 or less. You ask him for more help [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he does so ably; each Monster on a space of your choice loses 2 Health. If you fail, you despair; lose 1 Sanity.

You see an ad in the Saturday edition of the Sydney Morning Herald offering to teach survival skills in exchange for donating camping equipment. You may spend 1 Resource to improve [STRENGTH] and 1 other skill of your choice.

You discover an empty campsite and try to track down the missing campers [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a woman who kindly shares her knowledge and supplies; gain 1 Clue and 1 Resource. If you fail, the long search exhausts you; lose 1 Health.

A team of divers has recovered an item from the ocean's floor but cannot identify it [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you recognize the ancient treasure; gain 1 Artifact. If you fail, deep ones come at night to attack the crew and retrieve it; lose 1 Health.

The hospital is in desperate need of funds [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, one of the patients is deeply moved by your generosity; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, you cannot help and the suffering begets evil; a Monster ambushes you!

An old radio in your room begins to emit strange words from its speakers [LORE]. If you pass, you translate instructions to better yourself; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, the sounds have an unhealthy effect; gain a Corruption Condition.

The local villagers tell you that a lost treasure is hidden within a cave. You explore the dark caverns in search of the legendary object [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find it; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, you awaken a horror; a Monster ambushes you!

You encourage a depressed passenger to seek adventure [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you make a friend; gain 1 CHARACTER Unique Asset. If you fail, you are accused of making threats; move to nearest City space and gain a Detained Condition.

You unlock a warehouse filled with crates. Gain 1 Resource. Later you tell the police the boxes were yours [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they bring you another; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, they arrest you; gain a Detained Condition.

Your intended route has been blocked by falling rocks. You try to dig your way through [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you uncover a rare object as you dig; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, you must take a longer path; you become Delayed.

A masked stranger joins you on the deck, and you strike up a conversation [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, he tells you the news of his travels and offers you supplies; gain 1 Clue and 1 Resource. If you fail, he reveals his monstrous face; gain a Corruption Condition.

A local festival gives you a chance to speak with the city's denizens [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they are delighted by you and want to share what they know; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, they see you as dangerous; gain a Detained Condition.

Some garbage was left here by a previous traveler. You search through the piles of refuse [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find something useful; gain 1 random ITEM Asset from the deck. If you fail, you do not feel well after your fruitless search; lose 1 Health.

You overhear two smugglers talking about stolen goods, and you try to find their illicit cargo [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a hidden panel; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, the smugglers intercept you; gain an INJURY Condition.

This idyllic city is invigorating but expensive. Recover 1 Health and 1 Sanity. You ask the locals about finding bargains [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they provide discounts; gain 1 Resource. If you fail, everything costs dearly; gain a Debt Condition.

Human traffickers hope to capture you alive [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you overpower them instead and learn their methods; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you get dragged off in chains; move to the nearest City space and gain a Detained Condition.

Several rare species of animals can be found on this unchartered island. You try to capture a large, ferocious beast [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you find a bloody journal in the creature's lair; gain 1 Clue. If you fail, it mauls you; lose 1 Health.

A stranger at the bank owes a large sum. You offer to help [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, the grateful stranger vows to aid in your struggles; gain 1 CHARACTER Unique Asset. If you fail, you cannot afford the price on your own; gain a Debt Condition.

The terrible isolation of this area is making it hard for you to sleep [WILL]. If you pass, a good night's rest leaves you feeling better than you ever have; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, the insomnia leaves you on edge; lose 1 Sanity.

You learn that a gangster plans to kill a passenger over a debt. You confront the crook [STRENGTH]. If you pass, the passenger becomes a loyal friend; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, you are unable to stop him; lose 2 Sanity.

The hotel's security informs you a guest has been abducted [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you track down the kidnappers and rescue their victim; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck. If you fail, you read of the victim's death in the news; lose 1 Sanity.

A sinkhole has opened in the ground nearby, revealing the topmost corner of a tomb buried by some ancient civilization. Uncovering the rest of the tomb will require supplies. You may spend 1 Resource to gain 1 Artifact.

A singing woman can be heard somewhere across the water. You try to interpret her strange words [LORE]. If you pass, the lyrics lead you to a floating corpse and an odd item; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, the music haunts you; lose 1 Sanity.

On the other side of the portal, you find yourself in an empty city with enormous primitive buildings made of green stone. As the city begins to shake and flood, you realize where you are and try to manipulate the portal to escape [LORE].

You are shocked to see a younger version of yourself participating in the cult ritual that opened this portal, despite you having no memory of doing so. Resolve the pass effect to observe the ritual; or resolve the fail effect to interrupt it.

You discover an era of technological marvels. Using a small handheld device, people are able to communicate with others around the globe and access vast amounts of knowledge. You try to figure out how to use one of these devices [LORE - 1].

You find the means to seal this doorway. Close this Gate. There is plenty of other information, but much of it is lies [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you identify the truth; gain 2 Clues. If you fail, you give more than you can afford to a struggling Nigerian prince; gain a Debt Condition.

Your search leads to darkness and horrors. Lose 1 Sanity. You find images and descriptions of cults and their blasphemous rites [WILL]. If you pass, you learn what you need; close this Gate. If you fail, you become their victim; gain a Cursed Condition.

The other you points to a letter that describes how to seal the portal. Close this Gate. The letter also contains an ancient rite [LORE]. If you pass, you perform the rite correctly; gain 1 Spell. If you fail, the rite changes you; gain a Corruption Condition.

You think that if you provide your future self with supplies, you may recover and seal this portal. You may spend 1 Resource to close this Gate. Whether you spend the Resource or not, you cannot endure knowing that this will be your fate. Gain an Amnesia Condition.

Whispers in your ear cause you to spin about, but there is no one there [WILL]. If you pass, you remain focused and can identify certain words in the whispers; gain this Clue. If you fail, you succumb to the whispers' promises of power and fortune; gain a Corruption Condition.

Here, away from civilization, you feel as if you can be free from the shackles that bind you [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you notice dramatic changes in the behaviors of your traveling companions as you sail farther out to sea; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

A cloaked figure asks you to deliver a package in return for some information [OBSERVATION - 1]. Words roll across the waves, reverberating through the channels of your thoughts [WILL]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a Corruption Condition. If you pass, you shiver and draw your coat close around you, rejecting the message imparted upon you by the otherworldly words; gain this Clue.

You reason with a frightened young man who you suspect is a recent recruit for a local cult [INFLUENCE].
