You search the scorched area to the best of your abilities [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find evidence that an expedition once based its camp here; gain this Clue. If you fail, you remain too long in the tainted area and a sickly blight seeps under your skin; gain 1 Eldritch token.

A booming voice echoes across the water, terrible and wonderful. It speaks to your innermost desires and promises to give you what no power on earth could possibly grant. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

The Order of the Bloated Woman contacts you with a proposal. In return for revealing the secrets of their sect, you must provide them with a single vial of your blood. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You find a small, gem-encrusted amulet. Gain 1 Eldritch token. Enamored by its sparkle, you gaze into its starry, multicolored facets, and it offers to show you what it has seen [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the amulet bonds with you; gain this Clue and 1 Tempted by Darkness Unique Asset.

Visions of those you have hurt weigh heavily on your conscience [WILL]; roll 1 fewer die for each Eldritch token you have. If you pass, you suspect you have been intentionally led down this path by another and forgive yourself; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

You find the long-winded journal of an extremely verbose cultist [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you manage to sift through the absurdly detailed accounts and begin work to undo the unspeakable evils that were perpetrated by the author; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

You find a dying Yithian that was left for dead by the Cult of the Sand Bat. You know that you should put the doomed creature out of its misery, but at the same time, you could learn much from watching it expire. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

When the crew asks you to join them up on deck, you find it nearly impossible to resist [WILL]. If you pass, you reject their offer but secretly watch as they conduct dark rituals; gain this Clue. If you fail, you black out, waking hours later with no memory of your actions; gain a Corruption Condition.

You meet with the Order of the Bloated Woman in the inner sanctum of their local headquarters. Gain 1 Eldritch token. You do your best to convince them you can be trusted [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they gift you a curio from their treasury; gain this Clue and 1 Tempted by Darkness Unique Asset.

This area has been contaminated by communion with the Bloody Tongue. You carefully make your way toward the ritual site [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find the ceremonial setting still intact; gain this Clue. If you fail, extended exposure to the area affects you severely; gain 1 BANE Condition.

Your ship is boarded by deep ones, but they do not attack. Instead their leader snarls at you, claiming that they will join forces with you to lay waste to the plans of one of your mutual enemies. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

The endless crises are starting to wear on you. Staying on the straight and narrow when everyone around you is slowing you down has become infuriating, and you would give anything for just a little more power. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

The wall of a long forgotten cave is covered in intricate murals [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you recognize that the images are depicting the Outer God Nyarlathotep and you take solace that the entities in the mural are resisting him; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

You meet with the deep ones, who claim that their master is willing to hear you out [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, you learn of a great enmity between the Dreamer and the Messenger; gain this Clue. If you fail, they dismiss you, unwilling to work together against a common foe; advance Doom by 1.

You try to appeal to the people of the city to unite against the common enemy [INFLUENCE]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a Dark Pact Condition. If you pass, they pass you information; gain this Clue. If you fail, they deem you untrustworthy and play directly into Nyarlathotep's schemes; advance Doom by 1.

You find a black stream flowing where none should be, and it whispers secrets to you that no man should know. It entreats you to drink deeply of its murky waters. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

A pharaonic entity appears above the ship, radiant and terrifying. Lose 1 Health for each Eldritch token you have. It presents you with a confusing riddle [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, your answer satisfies it and it leaves you a parting gift; gain this Clue and 1 Tempted by Darkness Unique Asset.

You try to translate an ancient Egyptian text that instructs the reader on the creation of defensive wards [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you are able to replicate a ward that was used in times of old to hide the viewer from the sight of the Dark Pharaoh; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

The sun is suddenly blotted out by a black wind, and you feel insanity peeling away the layers of your psyche [WILL]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a Corruption Condition. If you pass, you hear words on the roar of the wind; gain this Clue. If you fail, your mind is shattered; lose 3 Sanity.

You fade into the Dreamlands as you sleep. You travel for many years, eventually coming to the obsidian gates of Kadath. A lone gatekeeper agrees to tell you of the castle's master in exchange for part of your soul. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

A representative from the Order of the Bloated Woman wishes you to side with her organization against local competition. In return, she will grant you access to the Order's vast network of assets. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You try to breach the dense fog growing in your mind [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you break through into the sunlight, basking in its warmth and relishing another day of life before you wake to the madness of reality; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

You search the horizon for signs of danger [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you see a black infection spreading through the water in the distance; gain this Clue. If you fail, the ship sails directly into an unnatural fog; gain 1 Eldritch token.

One of your contacts is concerned about your exposure to dark forces and is wary of working with you [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, she acquiesces and teaches you to better protect yourself; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token. If you fail, she skips town; discard this Clue.

The black of night falls heavily upon your shoulders, seeking entry into your being. You have kept it at bay for so long, but with how complicated things have become, you cannot help but wonder which path to take. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You study the flow of the currents, searching for any irregularities [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, the currents predict some imminent celestial event; gain this Clue. If you fail, the longer you study the ocean, the greater the urge to dive in and become one of the sea's children becomes; gain 1 Eldritch token.

A clandestine organization tests your ability to resist interrogation [WILL]. If you pass, they deem you worthy of a secret that may save all of mankind; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token. If you fail, your willpower is found to be lacking; lose 2 Health.

An ethereal voice beckons you to follow, and you are unable to resist. If you have a Dark Pact Condition, gain a Corruption Condition. You feel as if you are an outside observer in your own body, but you try to remember what the voice says [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you retain your memories; gain this Clue.

The memory of the being that charged you to come to this tiny island is hazy. You know that you should leave the unbroken seal before you untouched, but you want answers, and it is the only way you can think to get them. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

According to the library's records, the book you have found does not exist. As your fingers graze its weathered pages, you can feel the book evaluating your usefulness. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain the True Magick Artifact.

The Cult of the Sand Bat traps you and attempts to control your mind [WILL]; roll 1 fewer die for each Eldritch token you have. If you pass, the ritual has no effect; gain this Clue. If you fail, you lose control of your body for several hours as you do their bidding; advance Doom by 1.

You set out on a voyage of self-reflection, hoping to clear your mind and renew your crumbling faith in humanity [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you spot an omen of hope in the starry night sky; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

The Silver Twilight Lodge invites you to one of their meetings. Gain this Clue unless you have 2 or more Eldritch tokens. The group tries to convince you to come into the inner sanctum [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you fail, you are unable to resist and see things that should not be seen; gain 2 MADNESS Conditions.

A hidden glade exists outside of time and space [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you manage to locate it, and its keeper provides you with a gift so that you can easily return; gain the Hemisphere Map Artifact. If you fail, you find only despair in the wilderness; gain a Corruption Condition.

The crew has been paid by the Order of the Bloated Woman to transport a prisoner, but they would be willing to release their captive for the right price. You may gain a Debt Condition to gain this Clue and 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck.

The strange stone is reported to be linked to the Father of Bats, but touching it even for a moment requires inhuman endurance [STRENGTH]. If you pass, you learn some of the Father's plans; gain this Clue. If you fail, darkness beyond reality fills your mind; gain 1 Eldritch token.

You try to find your way through a dense fog that seemingly appeared from nowhere [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find your way safely; gain this Clue. If you fail, you remain in the fog for hours, and you feel as if the fog is alive and attempting to smother you; gain 1 BANE Condition.

Stowed away aboard the Dark Mistress, you find a hidden compartment. Inside, you find an elaborate Chinese fan. Touching the fan, even for a moment, fills you with fear, and you question whether you should leave it be. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Black Fan Artifact.

His toothy smile makes your skin itch and crawl, but he claims to have intimate knowledge of the schemes of the Outer Gods. You wonder how this could possibly be true, but his information seems legitimate. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain The Messenger Unique Asset.

You make a pact with Nodens to secure the future of the Dreamlands [INFLUENCE]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a DEAL Condition. If you pass, he tells you of the movements of the enemy; gain this Clue. If you fail, he believes you to be corrupted by Nyarlathotep and smites you; lose 3 Health.

You chart a voyage through unknown waters [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you arrive at your destination before the Order of the Bloated Woman has a chance to desecrate it; gain this Clue. If you fail, bureaucracy and incompetence slow your journey, filling you with rage; gain 1 Eldritch token.

Two competing agencies claim to know the secrets of the enemy. You suspect that one of them is working for him, and try to determine which [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you choose your friends wisely; gain this Clue. If you fail, you choose your alliances poorly; gain 1 Eldritch token.

A hardy looking man questions you regarding what you know about Nyarlathotep [INFLUENCE]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a Corruption Condition. If you pass, he joins forces with you; gain the Jack Brady Unique Asset. If you fail, he believes you to be an enemy and attacks; lose 2 Health.

An expedition, recently returning from a dig in Egypt, offers to sell you an item that they found within a hidden chamber of the Bent Pyramid. You may gain a Debt Condition to gain this Clue and 1 RELIC Unique Asset.

The Voice of the Messenger floods the city, and you fall to your knees, covering your ears. Lose 1 Sanity for each Eldritch token you have. In the madness that follows, you try to calm the people [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, they recount the words spoken to them by the Voice; gain this Clue.

You rest against a cool flat stone and observe the starry sky above [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, your knowledge of astronomy alerts you to an impending eclipse; gain this Clue. If you fail, you feel as if the stars are gazing down upon you with malicious intent; gain 1 Eldritch token.

No one else seems to see the man with the book standing on deck. He stands there, extending ink and a quill to you, enticing you to sign. You hesitate as he flips the pages of the charcoal-black book to an empty page. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Black Book Artifact.

Agents marked by the yellow sign deliver to you a grim missive. The dark within the Hyades will keep the enemy at bay, so long as you fulfill your end of the bargain. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to retreat Doom by 1.

You follow a meowing tabby cat as it weaves to and fro through a wooded glade [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you arrive at last at a clearing where Bast herself grants you protection from the evil that threatens the cats of the Dreamlands; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

Your dream takes you to the gates of Kadath. The doors open on their own accord, and a melodic, honey voice beckons you to enter [WILL]. If you pass, you remember the dream when you wake; gain this Clue. If you fail, your eyes blacken as you walk through; gain a Corruption Condition.

Your mole within the Brotherhood has been discovered and is being held for execution. You attempt a jailbreak, but are forced to choose between saving your contact's life and stopping a fell ritual. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck.

You try to decipher scrawlings left behind by the Carlyle expedition [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you learn that they broke the seal atop the Bent Pyramid, and also how to repair it; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you begin to lose hope that you can do anything to stop what is coming; gain 1 Eldritch token.

You look for contraband in the cargo hold [OBSERVATION]; roll 2 fewer dice if you have a DEAL Condition. If you pass, you find packages bound for Kenya; gain this Clue. If you fail, you are mysteriously drawn to a crate that contains a statuette of a horrific beast with a bloody tongue; gain 1 BANE Condition.

The police will help those who can be trusted. Gain this Clue unless you have a DEAL Condition. You return the favor by helping with an investigation into the Cult of the Bloody Tongue [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you fail, they believe you to be purposefully misleading them; gain a Detained Condition.

The infection in your body is not a physical one, but you work to purge it nonetheless [STRENGTH]. If you pass, your strength and determination win the day, and you feel refreshed and ready to take on the world; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

A solitary green spire rises from the ocean before the ship, and the sky darkens above you. No creatures of the deep accompany its arrival, but it resonates with a haunting, powerful melody, daring you to accept its fell blessing. You may gain a Corruption Condition to retreat Doom by 1.

You procure a cursed object reputed to be from the Dark Pharaoh's treasury [LORE]. If you pass, you manage to dispel its potent hex; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, the curse of the Dark Pharaoh brings ruin and misfortune to your life; gain 1 BANE Condition.

An elderly woman living in the woods tells you of her lifelong struggle against Nyarlathotep. She says that she is too old now to continue to fight, but that she would pass on her knowledge to you for a small sum of money. You may gain a Debt Condition to gain this Clue and improve [WILL].

A starry omen appears in the night sky, foretelling the coming of the Daemon Sultan [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you record the information quickly, hoping to use it to change the future; gain this Clue. If you fail, it disappears in an instant and you fall into despair; gain 1 Eldritch token.

You climb your way up the political chain, hoping to place yourself in a position to affect change in a rapidly darkening world, but you find that few can achieve power without sacrificing their innocence. You may gain a Corruption Condition to gain this Clue and improve [INFLUENCE].

You find someone trapped by a labyrinth within their own mind, and you attempt to guide them out with your voice [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you have made a new and loyal friend; gain 1 random ALLY Asset from the deck.

The King in Yellow speaks to you in a dream. If you have a Dark Pact Condition, gain 1 BANE Condition. You try to comprehend his horrific speech [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, he teaches you to avoid the gaze of the Crawling Chaos; gain this Clue and you may discard 1 Eldritch token.

You attempt to gather information about the vanished Carlyle expedition, but the people seem loathe to trust you [OBSERVATION]; roll 1 fewer die for each Eldritch token you have. If you pass, you manage to pick up a new lead; gain this Clue.

The sky turns bloody and red, and your skin crawls as the Dark Pharaoh steps forth from an unseen dimension. Your heart screams at you to resist, but what he has to offer could change everything. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 RELIC Unique Asset.

You sit cross-legged atop the crow's nest, contemplating the abyss within you [WILL]. If you pass, you are the master of your own destiny; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, your insides seethe with rage and hatred; gain a Corruption Condition.

A statue in the city square has an unusual inscription [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you intuit the glyphs to be empowered by temporal magic; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, your curiosity alerts the Order of Rising Stars to the location of the glyphs; advance Doom by 1.

You notice that the soil has been disturbed in this area [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you discover that an ancient burial site has been desecrated; gain this Clue. If you fail, you twist your ankle in the dirt; lose 1 Health.

Unusual flotsam smashes into the side of the ship, and something small catches your eye. As you pull the unusual object aboard the ship, you know instantly that it was never meant for mortal hands and that by taking it you will set yourself along a dark path from which there is no return. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain the Grotesque Statue Artifact.

Three men eat together at a diner. You attempt to pick out which belongs to the Order [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you ambush him after his meal and grill him for information on the Order; gain this Clue. If you fail, you attack an innocent person; gain a Detained Condition.

Suddenly, you cannot move or speak, and you are surrounded by chanting Order members [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you manage to escape with their strange words etched in your mind; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, your vision fades to black; place 2 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.
The only way to activate the strange island shrine and uncover its nefarious purpose is with a sacrifice of blood. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

The Order of Rising Stars is pursuing you relentlessly. You try to evade them [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you learn much of their methods; gain this Clue. If you fail, you go days without rest and begin to see them on every street corner; lose 1 Health and 1 Sanity.

It appears that the Order of Rising Stars has already drained this site and moved on, but there is some residual energy [WILL - 1]. If you pass, the area's energy becomes one with your own; gain this Clue and improve [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, the energy sickens you; lose 2 Health.

Deep ones are attacking the ship. Gain this Clue. One leaps at you. A Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet. If you defeat the Monster, you find an Order sigil on its corpse; gain 1 additional Clue.

The lights of the city dim, and the stars shine down upon you with a harsh light [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you discover a constellation that matches none of your star charts; gain this Clue. If you fail, your interest in the ever-nearing stars borders on obsession; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

The natives in this area come to you with a gift, insisting that the knowledge it contains will help you stop the Order [LORE]. If you pass, you are able to master the unusual object; gain this Clue. If you fail, the strange heirloom is beyond your ability to control; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

Stars shift and realign in the night sky, as if you have crossed dimensions into another time. Gain this Clue. Dread sets in and something terrible rises from beneath the waves. The Cthulhu Epic Monster ambushes you! If you are not defeated, you return to the present; gain 1 additional Clue.

You study Plato's Critias, hoping to find something that would explain what interest the Order of Rising Star has in Atlantis [LORE]. If you pass, you learn about the Atlantean's impressive collection of magical artifacts; gain this Clue. If you fail, you find nothing of worth; lose 1 Sanity.

You intercept an encrypted message that speaks of a midnight gathering far from civilization and try to locate the site of the meeting [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you observe the gathering in secret; gain this Clue. If you fail, you end up in the middle of nowhere; lose 1 Sanity and become Delayed.

Something calls to you from the sea floor [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you shake free but retain the memory of an ancient slumbering deity; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, you wake hours later, feeling as if your mind has been rifled through; place 2 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

You study a text that you believe to be written in the lost language of Naga-Maya [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you learn about the origin of mankind; gain this Clue. If you fail, your extended interest draws the unwanted attention of the Order of Rising Stars; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

Thousands of years regress in an instant, and you find yourself gazing at the night sky of millennia past [LORE]. If you pass, you sketch an accurate star map before returning to your own time; gain this Clue. If you fail, the stress of the journey weighs heavily on your psyche; lose 1 Sanity.

Deep ones are raiding the cargo hold. Gain this Clue. One of them notices you watching. A Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet. If you defeat the Monster, you find an Order missive on it; gain 1 additional Clue.

You break into the home of a suspected Order member and scrutinize her notes [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you quickly transcribe all that you find; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, she returns while you are rifling through her things; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

The Order of Rising Stars is holding a ceremony outside of town, and you attempt to attend in disguise [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you observe several of their rites; gain this Clue. If you fail, you are discovered and are nearly killed before making your escape; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You hear a chanting and try to quickly transcribe it word for word [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you meet success; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, the words call a beast; a Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

The Order of Rising Stars brazenly assaults you in broad daylight. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you defeat the Monster, the local police force tips you off to your assailant's numerous connections; gain this Clue.

You follow a group of deep ones as they make their way inland [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you remain undetected, and observe them meeting with Order members; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, they spot you, and you drop one of your things when you run; discard 1 ITEM possession.

You use arcane sight to look into dark waters [LORE]. If you pass, you feel an ancient power stirring; gain this Clue. If you fail, you attract unwanted attention; a Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

You delve into library archives in hope of learning about the City of the Great Race [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you uncover a detailed history; gain this Clue. If you fail, you black out suddenly, waking hours later with memories that are not your own; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

You overlay a star chart with a topographical map of the local area in search of an Order hideout [LORE]. If you pass, you align them successfully; gain this Clue. If you fail, the Order catches you snooping about long before you find their den; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

You dream this night of the deep, dark ocean. Something awaits you there, searching, dreaming. It reaches out to you, feeling for a window into the world above. You may advance the Omen by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

Many of the Order of Rising Stars ceremonial things have been left behind, and you think you could use them to piece together where the Order went. You may spawn 1 Gate to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

You suspect that you are being followed, but your pursuer is extremely stealthy [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a place to hide and watch as a deep one creeps along your path; gain this Clue. If you fail, you are hounded at every step of your journey; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

Paranoid from recent events, you are vigilant for any signs of activity in the water [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you notice dark waters frothing and churning on the horizon; gain this Clue. If you fail, you hardly notice someone approaching you from behind; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

A strange man claims to be a native of Pnakotus. You ask him for details [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he reveals that he is a member of the Great Race and shares knowledge of the City with you; gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you learn nothing of value; become Delayed.

You believe that you can learn much about the Order of Rising Stars by participating in one of their ceremonies, but you fear the consequences that path might bring. You may advance Doom by 1 to gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue.

Crates in the hold are rumored to contain supplies for the Order of Rising Stars [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you discover what the crates contain and toss them overboard; gain this Clue. If you fail, you cannot find them and the Order receives the full shipment; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

A traveling merchant claims to possess something revered from the lost city of Atlantis [INFLUENCE - 1]. If pass, you convince him to part with it; gain this Clue and 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, your loud haggling draws the attention of the Order; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

You enact a ritual to mask the night sky from the Order of Rising Stars [LORE]. If you pass, you watch them wander aimlessly in confusion; gain this Clue. If you fail, the stars only become clearer; advance the Omen by l.

You keep thinking that you see gleaming green spires out of the corner of your eye [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you manage to get a good look at one before it shimmers out of existence; gain this Clue and 1 additional Clue. If you fail, the sightings haunt you; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

A traveling storyteller offers to expand your mind if you have the fortitude to receive his gifts [WILL]. If you pass, the wisdom of civilizations lost is ingrained in your core; improve 1 skill of your choice. If you fail, you buckle beneath the weight of his words; lose 1 Sanity and gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

Members of the Order of Rising Stars have opened a portal to the distant past and ventured through it [LORE]. If you pass, you manage to discern to what time they have traveled; gain this Clue. If you fail, your meddling causes an anomaly; spawn 1 Gate.

You slip into a restricted area to investigate unusual noises coming from the crew quarters [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a journal detailing a gruesome transformation; gain this Clue. If you fail, you find no sign of the crew, only pools and smears of blood; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

As you sleep, you dream of an emerald city rising up from the ocean depths. Gain this Clue. You wake with a sudden jolt to find someone standing over you speaking unintelligible words. A Cultist Monster ambushes you!

A careless member of the Order of Rising Stars leads you to one of their abandoned hideouts [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a strange curio wrapped in seaweed; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, you trigger the defensive words that were placed when they departed; gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You find yourself dreaming of a bustling emerald city [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you observe the ways of the inhuman citizens that reside there; gain this Clue and 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you wake up trembling and drenched in seawater; place 2 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

You shake hands with a wealthy businesswoman who has taken an interest in your travels [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, she takes a liking to you and shares her secret to success with you; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, she finds your handshake to be entirely forgettable; lose 1 Sanity.

You find a single emerald spire protruding from the earth in an abandoned Order ritual site [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you identify a displacement of time and space in the area; gain this Clue. If you fail, the spire's haunting melody resonates in your mind; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

You arrive at an uncharted island before the Order has had a chance to explore it [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find something incredible; gain this Clue and 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, the Order performs a vile ritual and the island is swallowed by the sea; advance Doom by 1.

You search ancient texts for any indication of the existence of Hyperborea [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you find a fable about a maiden from Koth who made a pact with a time traveling sage; gain this Clue. If you fail, you conclude that the city never existed; discard this Clue.

You sit atop a boulder and meditate, becoming one with the scintillating emerald stars of Xoth [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you siphon some of the stars' power; close 1 Gate of your choice. If you fail, visions of the origin of the star spawn leave you a gibbering maniac; lose 3 Sanity.

You pursue a group of deep ones to their city. Gain this Clue. They fiercely defend their territory. A Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet. If you defeat the Monster, you study its corpse; improve [LORE].

You turn to the stars for guidance [LORE]. If you pass, your mind becomes tied to the astral memories of a blazing star; gain 1 Spell. If you fail, your mind lingers too long in the far reaches of time and space; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

The Order of Rising Stars is meeting with several other hooded figures [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you glimpse fish-like faces beneath their hoods; gain this Clue. If you fail, the group disperses and you know more than you did when you arrived; move this Clue to the nearest Sea space.

You sneak aboard a deep one vessel [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find and destroy a shrine to their master; gain this Clue and close the nearest Gate. If you fail, you are discovered; a Deep One Monster ambushes you; if you lose Sanity from the [WILL] test, place the lost Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

Minor temporal anomalies lead you to a gathering hall for the Order of Rising Stars during the middle of a ceremony. A Cultist Monster ambushes you! If you defeat the Monster, the ceremony is irrevocably disrupted and the flow of time returns to normal; gain this Clue and close the nearest Gate.

With each step you take, the wilderness around you appears more untouched, more ancient [LORE]. If you pass, you are able to understand the magic that is present in this area; gain 1 Spell. If you fail, the primal magic is far beyond your understanding; lose 1 Sanity.

The deep one vessel far outpaces your own. You struggle to maintain sight of the ship as it nears the horizon [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you stay on its tail long enough to know its destination; gain this Clue. If you fail, the ship vanishes into a heavy fog; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

A man who claims to belong to the Order of Rising Stars agrees to speak with you [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, he nervously agrees to cut all of his ties with the Order; retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, he panics and calls for the police, screaming that you attacked him; gain a Detained Condition.

You visit with a hermit who claims that he is being hunted by the Order of Rising Stars [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you realize the ageless hermit is from the city of Koth; gain this Clue. If you fail, the Order interrupts your questioning and drags the man away; place 1 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

The man holds a single finger to his lips, and you find that you cannot speak. He extends his hand to you, and in it lies a glittering ruby. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to gain this Clue and the Ruby of R'lyeh Artifact.

You attempt to harness the spiritual energy of civilization to glimpse into the past [LORE - 1]. If you pass, the energies flow through you and you witness Atlantis become lost beneath the waves; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, you accidentally travel to the future; advance the Omen by l.

There is a thundering crash and a blazing light streaks toward the earth, all manner of trees and plant life bursting into flames [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you quickly find where it landed and recover an antiquity of ages past; gain 1 MAGICAL Artifact. If you fail, you are badly burned; lose 2 Health.

The captain is acting strangely and at times seems as if he is less than human [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you realize that he is slowly becoming a creature of the sea; gain this Clue. If you fail, you awake one morning to find the ship manned entirely by deep ones; place 2 Sanity on the Ancient One sheet.

A mysterious traveler wordlessly looks you up and down [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, the traveler joins your entourage without explanation; gain 1 CHARACTER Unique Asset. If you fail, the traveler leaves hastily, face dark with worry and confusion; discard all of your Focus.

You attempt to absorb all of the arcane energy in the area, such that the Order might not be able to harness it [LORE - 1]. If you pass, your plan is a success; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, your attempt only makes you an easy target; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

Some of the ship's crew strike you as odd [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you notice that many of them sport fish-like facial features; gain this Clue. If you fail, the crew catches you eying them and teaches you a lesson; lose 1 Health and gain 1 INJURY Condition.

You investigate ties between the Order of Rising Stars and the fish-like men of the sea [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you learn that they have been spotted searching for sunken ruins together; gain this Clue. If you fail, you learn only misinformation; move this Clue to the nearest Sea space.

A handsome young man is studying some unusual flora [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you impress him by identifying the genus and species of the plant; gain the Jake Williams Unique Asset. A waterlogged book is pulled up with the rest of the day's haul [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you realize after some investigation that the book is written in an Atlantean script; gain this Clue and 1 Spell. If you fail, the book's latent magic warps the fabric of time and space; spawn 1 Gate.

You scour the ashes of a horrific fire for anything that can be recovered [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find a book entirely untouched by the flames, almost is if it had caused the fire itself; gain the Necronomicon Artifact. If you fail, the ash-filled air burns your lungs; lose 1 Health.

You chart the sites that the Order of Rising Stars has visited [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you believe that by linking them together you have discovered the next location; gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1. If you fail, you fail to notice one of them approach you; a Cultist Monster ambushes you!

A feeling of dread seeps under your skin, and you frantically search for the source [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you spot the shimmer of a long-dead city beneath the waves; gain this Clue. If you fail, you grow increasingly unstable as your journey continues; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You look into the affairs of the Order of Rising Stars [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, you find that they have been gathering texts regarding the lost continent of Mu; gain this Clue. You intercept a message meant for a priest of the Order of Rising Stars and try to decipher its intent [OBSERVATION]. The water begins to churn and roil, and you must react quickly [OBSERVATION - 1]. If you pass, the swirling vortex finds no easy prey today; gain this Clue and retreat Doom by 1. This area appears to have been destroyed by some cataclysm that left behind pools of brackish green water and a great deal of residual psychic energy. You search the terrain for survivors or anything else that may be of value to you [OBSERVATION - 1].

You find something. Gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. You try to harness the energy here [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you alter time; you may move the Omen counterclockwise by 1 without advancing Doom. If you fail, you rip open reality; spawn a Gate.

Looking down into a crevice, you see severed limbs. Lose 1 Sanity. You climb down to examine the carnage [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you see an object amid the horror; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, you fall; gain 1 Injury Condition.

The Yithians migrate to the future and the minds now trapped in their old bodies face flying polyps. Resolve the pass effect to save them and use what they know to alter fate; or resolve the fail effect to see if they can save themselves through portals.

You attempt to use a Pnakotic pentagon [LORE - 1]. If you pass, one creature is saved and it teaches you to overcome destiny; move the Omen to any space of the track without advancing Doom. If you fail, the flying polyps attack you; lose 1 Health.

It is horrifying to watch these creatures be torn apart [WILL - 1]. If you pass, you see one creature survive by opening and closing portals; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, the grisly scene traumatizes you; lose 1 Sanity.

You find several of the Yithians' lightning guns that have been discarded after ceasing to operate. You disassemble them in the hopes of understanding the complex mechanics involved in harnessing such powerful energies [LORE].

You adjust the devices to repair rifts torn between dimensions. Close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. Then a very small red light on the device begins to flash [OBSERVATION]. If you fail, you do not see the alert and the device explodes; lose 1 Health.

The item malfunctions and shows you all potential futures, most of which are bleak [WILL]. If you pass, you see a future in which you seal the door to another world; close 1 Gate of your choice on any space. If you fail, you feel doomed; lose 2 Sanity.

One of the strange conical beings shows you a picture of a specific leafy plant and directs you to a vast, lush garden. You search the assorted flora there for any specimens that match the image you were shown [OBSERVATION].

You find a rare object by the plant. Gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. You speak to the Yithian [INFLUENCE - 1]. If you pass, you trade the plant for an education; gain 1 TALENT Condition. If you fail, you awake with no memory; gain an Amnesia Condition.

You spend too long in the sun. Lose 1 Health. As you search, a carnivorous plant grabs you [STRENGTH]. If you pass, uprooting the plant reveals an object; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, the sap covers your skin; gain a Corruption Condition.

You find yourself alone on an airship powered by electrical repulsion. You examine both the engine and its controls, trying to figure out how to launch and pilot the bizarre craft and eventually see more of this ancient era [LORE - 1].

Once in the air, you search the night sky for familiar stars [OBSERVATION]. If you pass, you see the truth about constellations; move the Omen to any space of the track without advancing Doom. If you fail, the sky is utterly alien; gain 1 MADNESS Condition.

You ask a Yithian for help [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, it takes you on an informative tour of the night sky; you may move the Omen counterclockwise by 1 without advancing Doom. If you fail, you are shot with a lightning gun; lose 2 Health.

You believe that at some point in your future, you will be here, trapped in the body of a Yithian. You search the City of the Great Race, looking to find your future self, stuck in the form of one of these creatures [OBSERVATION - 1].

The other you offers a gift. Gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. He then writes a cryptic warning [LORE - 1]. If you pass, you understand; you may move the Omen counterclockwise by 1 without advancing Doom. If you fail, he scares you; lose 1 Sanity.

You fear you are being followed. Gain a Paranoia Condition. Your future self attacks [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you steal an object away from the other you; gain 1 RELIC Unique Asset. If you fail, your future self robs you to pay a debt; gain a Debt Condition.

The hallways stretch and bend as you wander them, the far end seemingly becoming farther and farther away. The walls rise and loom over you, and the single deafening tone of a blaring horn brings you swiftly to your knees [WILL].

You slowly and surely bring yourself back to your feet. Place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. The noise invades your mind until you can think of nothing else. Perhaps the noise would quiet if you would simply let it in. You may gain a Corruption Condition to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.

You concoct a bizarre solution that dissolves the necklace in seconds. Place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. You create a solution so vile that to even be in the same room is making your skin smoke and burn. You gasp for air as you crawl toward the necklace. You may gain a Corruption Condition to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.
Darkness fills the chamber, and a harsh wind blows around you as you spin about in fear. A malevolent feminine voice whispers in your ear promises of true power and of total destruction [WILL].

You resist temptation and steel yourself against the voice, which shrieks in rage. Place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. Something about the whispers appeals to you in a small, twisted way. The whisper turns to laughter and fades away, its work complete. You may gain a Corruption Condition to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.

Deep within the labyrinth lies the well preserved body of Queen Nitocris, and you will require the means to destroy it. The Elder God Nodens appears before you, and you plead with him to grant you the power needed to complete your task [INFLUENCE].

You feel power flowing through you as you touch the girdle. You smile as the temptation to don it yourself rises. Nobody would have to know. You may gain a Dark Pact to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.

Atop a pedestal sits a beautiful golden crown that once belonged to Queen Nitocris. You suspect that the Brotherhood of the Dark Pharaoh intends to use the crown in the ritual, and you attempt to focus your arcane power to destroy it [LORE].

Stumbling about in the darkness you bump into someone patrolling the area. You plead with the rather dull-looking man to keep quiet and avoid drawing the attention of flying polyps [INFLUENCE - 1].

The man calms down considerably and runs off into the darkness. Place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. You know that you should not let him leave, but neither do you want to stab him in the back. You may gain 1 Eldritch token to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.

The man shouts for his comrades, and in response, you hear the wretched shriek of a flying polyp. Lose 1 Sanity. You defend yourself against the beast [STRENGTH - 1]. If you pass, you manage to escape with your life; place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.
As you are exploring the city ruins, you encounter a strange conical creature with many tentacled appendages trapped in an electric cage [LORE - 1].

You recognize the creature as a Yithian. Place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. You speak with the creature to ascertain its purpose in the city [INFLUENCE]. If you pass, it tells you that it has been enslaved for its psychic abilities; place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure. If you fail, it tells you horrors about the origin of humanity; gain l MADNESS Condition.

You could never have imagined such a disturbing creature existed. Lose 2 Sanity. It speaks to you secretly using psychic abilities, offering power if you help it escape. You may gain a Dark Pact Condition to place 1 Eldritch token on the current Adventure.
